title: Credit Analyst with Financial Institutions (FI Credit Analyst)
description:
Role & responsibilities The Financial Institutions team covers the Financial Institutions portfolio across geographies, including Asia, Europe and Americas. As a member of the team, you will: Be responsible for independently reviewing and monitoring counterparties within the Financial Institutions portfolio, which includes Banks, Brokers, Central Clearing counterparties, Mortgage Originators, Insurers, and other Financial Institutions. Specifically, you will: Write credit reviews recommending credit ratings for counterparties. This includes an evaluation of a counterpartys business model, its credit profile, macro-economic and sector trends, financial analysis, performance vs its peers etc. Perform in-depth sector and peer reviews, highlighting key trends, growing risks and possible risk mitigation to be undertaken by the firm. Participate in due diligence calls. Monitor the performance of counterparties and closely track developments related to a counterparty, industry, economy, regulations, markets etc., which could adversely impact the credit profile. Where necessary, detailed notes with the view/outlook and appropriate risk management action will have to be sent to senior management within the Risk division. Assist regional analysts in setting and negotiating credit terms to be included in legal agreements with a counterparty. Present at various forums on critical developments Set or rationalize credit limits in conjunction with business activity with a counterparty Investigate limit excesses by liaising with Front Office, Operations and Exposure Analytics team, to determine the cause and escalate genuine breaches of credit policies Analyze stressed exposure under various scenarios and provide commentary on the same. Participate in ad-hoc projects related to rating methodology, portfolio monitoring, regulatory requirements etc.

title: Walk-in || Marketing Manager
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 29 Oct - 03 Nov
Timing: 10.00 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Located in: Gokhale Business Bay
Address: 6th Floor, A wing, Office No. A-602, opposite to City Pride, Paschimanagri, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra 411038
Contact: Vivek Bhatt (9175543822)

Sundarban Agro & Tourism Development Pvt. Ltd. is looking for talented, creative, and result-oriented marketing professionals for its Marketing Department. Candidates will be considered for the position of Marketing Manager or Marketing Executive based on their qualifications, experience, and capabilities. 
 The selected candidates will work on marketing and promotional activities for the company's real estate projects, farmhouse plots, agricultural land, agro-tourism offerings, and other business initiatives. 
 The role involves digital marketing, lead generation, brand development, social media management, advertising campaigns, content creation, market research, and coordination with the sales team. Candidates applying for the Manager position should also be capable of developing marketing strategies, managing budgets, supervising team members, and monitoring overall marketing performance. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Marketing Strategy and Planning Develop and implement marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives. Plan marketing activities for real estate projects, farmhouse plots, agricultural land, and agro-tourism offerings. Identify target audiences, customer segments, and potential markets. Prepare monthly marketing plans, promotional calendars, and campaign schedules. Develop strategies to improve brand awareness, generate enquiries, and support sales growth. Identify new marketing opportunities and recommend innovative promotional approaches. Coordinate with management and the sales team to align marketing activities with business targets. 
 2. Digital Marketing and Online Advertising Plan, execute, and monitor digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Facebook, Instagram, and other relevant platforms. Manage paid advertising campaigns for lead generation and brand promotion. Monitor campaign performance, advertising expenditure, cost per lead (CPL), and conversion metrics. Identify suitable target audiences based on location, interests, demographics, and campaign objectives. Optimize advertising campaigns to improve lead quality and marketing efficiency. Coordinate with digital marketing agencies or manage campaigns directly, depending on the candidate's expertise. Track website traffic, online enquiries, campaign performance, and digital marketing results. Explore new digital platforms and advertising opportunities to expand the company's reach. 
 3. Lead Generation and Sales Coordination Generate quality leads and enquiries for the company's real estate and agro-tourism projects. Develop marketing campaigns that attract prospective buyers, investors, and other relevant customer groups. Coordinate with the sales team to understand lead requirements, customer feedback, and conversion performance. Monitor lead quality, lead distribution, follow-up status, and conversion rates. Identify reasons for poor-quality leads or low conversions and recommend corrective actions. Support the sales team with project information, presentations, brochures, and promotional materials. Plan campaigns to increase site visits, customer meetings, bookings, and business opportunities. Maintain records of campaign-generated leads and prepare performance reports. 
 4. Social Media Management Manage the company's social media presence across relevant platforms. Plan and maintain a monthly social media content calendar. Coordinate the creation and publication of posts, reels, videos, stories, and promotional content. Develop content ideas highlighting project features, locations, infrastructure, investment opportunities, and agro-tourism experiences. Monitor audience engagement, enquiries, comments, and messages. Maintain consistent brand identity, tone, and communication across social media channels. Track engagement, reach, follower growth, and enquiry generation. Explore creative content formats to improve brand visibility and audience engagement. 
 5. Branding and Content Development Maintain and strengthen the company's brand identity across marketing channels. Coordinate the development of brochures, flyers, banners, presentations, advertisements, project profiles, and other promotional materials. Prepare marketing briefs, campaign concepts, and content requirements for designers and content creators. Ensure promotional content is accurate, professional, and aligned with approved project information. Coordinate photography, videography, project walkthroughs, customer testimonials, and promotional videos where required. Develop marketing content for websites, landing pages, social media, email campaigns, and other communication channels. Ensure consistency in logos, brand guidelines, messaging, and visual presentation. 
 6. Offline Marketing and Promotional Activitie s Plan and coordinate offline marketing campaigns and local promotional activities. Manage the development and distribution of printed marketing materials. Coordinate exhibitions, property events, promotional stalls, customer meetings, and project launches. Explore opportunities for outdoor advertising, local partnerships, referral campaigns, and community outreach. Support field marketing activities and promotional events at project locations. Coordinate with vendors for printing, advertising placements, event arrangements, and promotional materials. Evaluate the effectiveness of offline campaigns and recommend improvements. 
 7. Market Research and Competitor Analysis Research real estate market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities. Study competitor pricing communication, promotional strategies, digital presence, and advertising campaigns. Identify new customer segments and potential geographical markets. Gather customer feedback and market insights to improve marketing strategies. Analyse campaign results and identify opportunities to improve performance. Share market research findings and recommendations with management. 
 8. Website and Online Presence Coordinate website content updates, project information, landing pages, and promotional banners. Work with website developers or agencies to improve user experience and enquiry generation. Ensure online project information and marketing content are accurate and up to date. Support search engine optimization (SEO), keyword research, and organic website traffic growth. Monitor website enquiries and coordinate improvements to enquiry forms and lead capture processes. Maintain consistency between website content, advertising campaigns, and other digital communication. 
 9. Marketing Analytics and Reporting Monitor campaign performance, advertising budgets, lead generation, and marketing expenditure. Track key performance indicators such as cost per lead, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on marketing investment. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketing reports. Maintain records of campaign performance, marketing activities, vendor expenses, and promotional schedules. Use Excel, spreadsheets, CRM platforms, and analytics tools to organize and analyse marketing data. Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend data-driven improvements. Present marketing performance updates and recommendations to management. 
 10. Vendor and Agency Coordination Coordinate with digital marketing agencies, advertising agencies, graphic designers, printers, photographers, videographers, and content creators. Prepare briefs and communicate campaign requirements, timelines, and expected deliverables. Monitor the quality and timely delivery of marketing materials. Coordinate quotations, campaign schedules, and marketing-related expenditure within approved budgets. Evaluate vendor performance and recommend improvements where necessary. 
 11. Team Management and Leadership Primarily for Manager-Level Candidates Lead, guide, and supervise marketing executives and other assigned team members. Allocate responsibilities and monitor the completion of marketing tasks. Establish marketing objectives, campaign timelines, and performance standards. Review team performance and provide guidance to improve productivity. Coordinate with sales, operations, and management teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing activities. Manage marketing budgets and prioritize campaigns based on business requirements. Develop reporting systems and processes to improve accountability and efficiency. Take ownership of overall marketing performance and recommend strategies for business growth. 
 12. Additional Responsibilities Maintain proper documentation of marketing plans, campaign reports, vendor details, and promotional activities. Ensure timely execution of assigned marketing projects and management instructions. Travel to project locations for photography, campaign planning, market research, and promotional activities when required. Maintain confidentiality of company information, marketing strategies, budgets, and customer data. Perform other marketing-related responsibilities assigned by management. 
 Required Skills Digital Marketing Real Estate Marketing Marketing Strategy and Planning Google Ads and Meta Ads Facebook and Instagram Marketing Social Media Management Lead Generation and Campaign Management Brand Management and Development Content Marketing SEO and Website Marketing Marketing Analytics and Reporting Market Research and Competitor Analysis Cost Per Lead (CPL) and ROI Analysis Marketing Budget Management Graphic Design and Creative Brief Coordination Vendor and Agency Management MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office Communication and Presentation Skills Team Coordination and Leadership Time Management and Problem-Solving Skills 
 Candidate Requirements Education: Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field. MBA in Marketing is preferred for Manager-level candidates. Experience: 26 years of relevant marketing experience. Candidates with experience in real estate, property marketing, farmhouse projects, agricultural land, hospitality, tourism, or related industries will be preferred. Knowledge of digital marketing, online advertising, social media, lead generation, and campaign management. Ability to plan marketing activities and analyse campaign performance. Strong communication, coordination, organizational, and analytical skills. Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM systems, analytics tools, or marketing automation platforms will be an advantage. Manager-level candidates should have experience in marketing strategy, budget management, team supervision, and performance reporting. Executive-level candidates should demonstrate hands-on execution skills, creativity, willingness to learn, and the ability to manage day-to-day marketing activities. Knowledge of Marathi, Hindi, and English is preferred. Willingness to travel to project sites and attend marketing events when required. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Quality and volume of leads generated. Cost per lead and campaign efficiency. Marketing contribution to site visits and sales conversions. Advertising budget utilization and return on marketing investment. Social media reach, engagement, and audience growth. Timely completion of campaigns and promotional activities. Website traffic and online enquiry generation. Brand visibility and marketing material quality. Accuracy and timeliness of marketing reports. Team productivity and achievement of marketing objectives for Manager-level candidates. 
 Position and Salary The final designation and compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, technical knowledge, practical skills, and interview performance. Marketing Executive: Suitable for candidates with 1–3 years of experience who can execute day-to-day marketing activities. Marketing Manager: Suitable for candidates with approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience who can independently plan marketing strategies, manage campaigns and budgets, coordinate teams, and take ownership of marketing performance.

Key Skills: Strategic planning,Estate,Google Ads,Generation,Performance Marketing,Campaigns,Strategic marketing,Social media marketing

title: Assistant Manager - Marketing
description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience Required: - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred OR - 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Hotel Marketing and Advertising - Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams. - Partners with Operations, Food Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel. - Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions. - Manages FB media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts. - Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups - Executes email marketing, and display advertising. - Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives. - Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice. Social Media Content Management - Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites). - Develops and executes promotions campaign in FB, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels. - Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly. Public Relations and Visual Asset Management - Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM. - Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers. - Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system. - Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets. - Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities. - Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives. - Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution. - Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s). - Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel. - Supports the co-ordination of photography for FB advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams. - Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team. - Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice. Direct Marketing and Collateral Development - Coordinates and executes Hotel and FB printed materials. - Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner. - Assists in the production of all property, FB display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas. - Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis. - Manages the execution of FB direct marketing activities. - Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA). General - Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property FB promotions and campaigns. - Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s). - Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary. - Assists in the liaison and execution of joint FB promotions. - Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis. - Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy. - Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders. - Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance. - Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Marketing Manager | IND Institute of NeuroDevelopment 
 Job Description 
 About IND The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a mission-driven organisation dedicated to improving the developmental journeys of children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences. Our services include assessments, consultations, therapy, parent education, professional training, research, webinars and educational programmes. We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Marketing Manager who understands consumer psychology, brand positioning, demand generation and integrated marketing. The ideal candidate will be able to develop marketing strategies, build compelling campaigns and drive measurable business outcomes across online and offline channels. This is an opportunity to build and strengthen the marketing function of a growing organisation while contributing to a meaningful mission. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Marketing Strategy & Brand Development Develop and execute marketing strategies for IND's services, programmes and products. Define target audiences, customer segments, positioning, value propositions and key messaging. Strengthen brand awareness, differentiation and trust among parents, professionals and other relevant audiences. Identify market opportunities and develop strategies to generate demand. 2. Campaign Planning & Execution Conceptualise and manage integrated marketing campaigns from planning to execution. Develop campaign objectives, messaging, offers, customer journeys and channel strategies. Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, designers and other partners to ensure effective execution. Test new campaign ideas and optimise performance based on results. 3. Consumer Research & Audience Understanding Understand customer needs, motivations, concerns, aspirations and decision-making behaviour. Identify barriers to engagement and conversion. Use customer feedback, market research and campaign data to improve marketing strategies. 4. Content Marketing & Communication Collaborate with content writers, storytellers, designers and video teams to develop effective marketing content. Plan educational content, awareness campaigns, thought leadership, webinars, videos, email campaigns and lead magnets. Ensure content supports brand positioning, audience engagement and demand generation. 5. Digital Marketing & Demand Generation Develop marketing strategies across social media, search, YouTube, email, WhatsApp, websites and digital advertising. Work closely with the Digital Growth Manager to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness. Identify opportunities through organic content, paid campaigns, partnerships, referrals, webinars and communities. Evaluate the effectiveness of digital channels within the broader marketing strategy. 6. Customer Journey & Conversion Funnel Map and optimise the customer journey from awareness to enquiry, consultation, programme enrolment and retention. Work with sales and community engagement teams to understand lead quality, customer objections and conversion challenges. Develop strategies to improve lead nurturing, conversion rates, retention and referrals. 7. Marketing Analytics & Performance Track and analyse qualified leads, conversion rates, cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost and marketing ROI. Evaluate campaign performance against defined objectives. Use data and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness and resource allocation. 8.  About Giovatto Advertising 
 Giovatto Advertising is a US-based advertising agency headquartered in Paramus, New Jersey. We specialize in delivering results-driven advertising and digital marketing solutions, with a strong focus on the automotive dealership industry. We are hiring an experienced Senior Performance Marketing Specialist to manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns for our US-based clients. This is a full-time remote contract opportunity for a highly motivated professional based in India who can independently manage advertising accounts, troubleshoot technical issues, and consistently improve campaign performance. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment, takes ownership of their work, and focuses on delivering measurable results rather than simply managing campaigns. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Paid Advertising Campaign Management Independently manage campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Microsoft/Bing Ads, and Programmatic Advertising platforms . Set up, launch, monitor, and optimize Google Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns. Tracking, Analytics & Technical Implementation Demonstrate strong hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and Conversions API (CAPI) . Conduct regular account audits to ensure accurate tracking, targeting, and campaign configurations. Work with website and development teams when required to resolve technical tracking issues. 3. Campaign Performance & Optimization Monitor campaign performance daily and proactively identify areas for improvement. Analyze key performance indicators, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversions, and ROAS. Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions quickly. Recommend campaign restructuring, budget reallocations, creative testing, and targeting improvements. Maintain strong account performance while ensuring effective budget utilization. Prepare performance reports with clear insights, observations, and actionable recommendations. 4. Account Management & Team Collaboration Take full ownership of assigned advertising accounts and campaign performance. Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. Collaborate with US-based teams to execute campaign strategies and resolve issues. Provide timely campaign updates and communicate performance challenges proactively. Ensure assigned work is completed accurately and on schedule with minimal supervision. 
 Required Skills & Experience 5–8 years of hands-on experience in paid media or performance marketing. Strong expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Microsoft Advertising, and programmatic campaigns. Advanced knowledge of GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and campaign attribution. Proven experience managing multiple paid advertising accounts and substantial advertising budgets. Strong understanding of Search, Display, Performance Max, lead generation, and remarketing strategies. Ability to independently audit, set up, troubleshoot, and optimize advertising accounts. Excellent analytical skills with a solution-oriented approach. Strong time management, attention to detail, and multitasking abilities. Good written and verbal English communication skills. Experience working in a fast-paced digital marketing agency. Willingness to work full-time during US Eastern business hours. 
 Preferred Skills Experience managing paid advertising for US automotive dealerships . Knowledge of Vehicle Ads, inventory-based advertising, and automotive lead generation. Experience with Google Merchant Center, Google Ads Editor, and Looker Studio. Familiarity with programmatic DSP platforms such as DV360 or The Trade Desk. Experience with CRM integrations, offline conversion tracking, and lead quality optimization. Google Ads or Meta certifications. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for a professional who is: Hands-on: Can independently build, launch, audit, and optimize campaigns. Performance-driven: Focused on improving campaign results and generating qualified leads. Solution-oriented: Identifies problems quickly and implements practical solutions. Accountable: Takes ownership of account performance and assigned responsibilities. Organized: Effectively manages multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines. Proactive: Recommends improvements without waiting for instructions. Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced US advertising agency. 
 Salary & Working Conditions Compensation: USD $800–$1,000 per month, depending on experience and expertise. Employment: Full-Time Contract. Location: 100% Remote from India. Workweek: Monday to Friday. Shift: Fixed US Eastern business hours, with Indian working hours adjusting according to US daylight saving time. Equipment: Candidates must have their own laptop/computer, reliable high-speed internet, and suitable remote workspace. Joining: Immediate availability strongly preferred. 
 How to Apply

Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Programmatic Advertising. Experience managing US automotive dealership advertising accounts, if any. Approximate monthly advertising budgets managed. Experience with GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking. Current and expected monthly compensation.  Role Overview We are looking for an Accounts & Finance professional to manage day-to-day banking operations, bank accounting, bank reconciliation, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and related accounting activities . title: Manager / Sr Manager - Finance ( Trade Accounts Payable)
description:
Role & responsibilities To lead the Trade Accounts Payable function , ensuring accurate and timely accounting of vendor invoices, effective vendor reconciliations, timely payments, and compliance with applicable statutory requirements and company policies. The role will be responsible for strengthening financial controls, improving working capital management, and driving process standardization and automation using Oracle ERP. 
 A. Trade Invoice Processing and Accounting Manage end-to-end Trade AP operations team, including receipt, validation, accounting, reconciliation, and settlement of vendor invoices. Ensure timely and accurate accounting of purchase invoices , debit notes, credit notes, rate differences, claims, and other trade-related adjustments managed by Other income team. Monitor three-way matching of purchase orders, goods receipts, and vendor invoices , ensuring discrepancies are resolved promptly. Ensure appropriate accounting of inventory purchases, purchase returns, vendor discounts, rebates, incentives, and other commercial adjustments in coordination with Procurement, Supply Chain, Category, and Inventory teams. Ensure correct vendor master mapping, accounting classifications, cost centre allocations, and tax codes. Monitor invoice ageing, blocked invoices, unprocessed invoices, and pending approvals to ensure timely closure. 
 B. Vendor Reconciliation and Payment Management Ensure periodic reconciliation of vendor statements with company books and timely resolution of outstanding differences. Monitor vendor advances, debit balances, unapplied credits, open GR/IR balances, and long-pending vendor items. Coordinate with Treasury and business teams to ensure vendor payments are processed within agreed credit terms. Resolve vendor escalations relating to payment delays, invoice disputes, deductions, and reconciliations. Establish effective controls to prevent duplicate invoices, duplicate payments, incorrect vendor payments, and unauthorized adjustments. Support working capital optimization through effective management of vendor payment terms and outstanding liabilities. 
 C. Oracle ERP Operations and Process Improvement Drive effective utilization and continuous improvement of Oracle ERP for Trade AP operations. Review Oracle configurations and transaction flows relating to purchase orders, receipts, invoice matching, accounting, payment processing, and vendor reconciliations. Identify process gaps, system issues, recurring errors, and opportunities for automation. Work with IT, Procurement, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to resolve Oracle-related issues and strengthen end-to-end process integration. Develop automated reports and dashboards for invoice ageing, pending approvals, reconciliation status, blocked invoices, and payment performance. Drive standardization of processes, reduction of manual interventions, and elimination of repetitive activities through automation. Support user acceptance testing (UAT), system enhancements, and implementation of new business requirements. 
 D. Financial Controls, Audit and Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable GST, TDS, Income Tax, accounting standards, and internal finance policies, as relevant to Trade AP transactions. Ensure appropriate validation of GSTIN, tax rates, place of supply, invoice particulars, and other applicable GST requirements. Monitor timely and accurate TDS deduction, deposit, reporting, and reconciliation wherever applicable. Ensure appropriate controls for input tax credit eligibility, vendor compliance, and reconciliation with GST records. Maintain adequate documentation and audit trails for all material transactions and adjustments. Coordinate with Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, IFC, and other assurance teams for Trade AP-related requirements. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Review key financial controls periodically and recommend improvements to strengthen the control environment. 
 E. Month-End Closure and Financial Reporting Ensure timely closure of Trade AP books in line with monthly MIS and financial reporting timelines. Review outstanding GR/IR balances, unrecorded liabilities, invoice accruals, goods received but not invoiced, and other relevant period-end adjustments. Ensure completeness and accuracy of trade payables, vendor liabilities, purchase accounting, and related balance sheet schedules. Review ageing reports, reconciliation statements, provisions, and other Trade AP-related financial schedules. Coordinate with Financial Accounting, Procurement, Inventory, and Supply Chain teams to resolve open items before book closure. Ensure timely submission of management reports and accurate information for financial analysis and decision-making. 
 F. Team Management and Stakeholder Coordination Lead, mentor, and develop the Trade AP and Other income team, ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and productivity. Establish team-level KPIs and review performance regularly against agreed targets. Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Category, Supply Chain, Inventory, Treasury, Tax, IT, and external vendors. Drive timely resolution of stakeholder queries and vendor escalations. Develop SOPs, process documentation, training materials, and standard operating dashboards. Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, accuracy, and customer-centric service delivery. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Invoice Processing: Percentage of valid invoices accounted for within the defined SLA. Month-End Closure: Completion of Trade AP activities within agreed closing timelines. Vendor Reconciliation: Percentage of vendor balances reconciled within the defined frequency and SLA. Invoice Backlog: Reduction in overdue, unprocessed, and blocked invoices. Payment Accuracy: Prevention of duplicate, incorrect, or unauthorised payments. Statutory Compliance: Timely and accurate GST and TDS compliance applicable to Trade AP. GR/IR Management: Reduction in aged and unresolved GR/IR balances. Audit Compliance: Timely closure of audit observations with no recurring control deficiencies. Automation and Productivity: Delivery of measurable process improvements and automation initiatives. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Timely resolution of vendor and internal stakeholder queries. Team Productivity: Achievement of agreed productivity, quality, and SLA targets. Oracle Process Effectiveness: Reduction in manual workarounds, recurring system issues, and transaction errors. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Strong understanding of Trade Accounts Payable and procure-to-pay processes. Good knowledge of inventory accounting, purchase accounting, GR/IR accounting, vendor reconciliations, and commercial adjustments. Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and applicable accounting and financial control requirements. Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP, preferably Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials or Oracle E-Business Suite. Strong analytical, problem-solving, reconciliation, and financial reporting skills. Experience in process optimization, automation, and ERP-driven controls. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and vendor dispute resolution skills. Proven team management and people development capabilities. Advanced Excel skills and experience with MIS dashboards or reporting tools. Ability to manage high transaction volumes and deliver within tight month-end closure timelines. 
 6. Experience and Qualification Requirements 4-6 years of overall experience in Finance and Accounts, with substantial experience in Trade AP / Procure-to-Pay operations . At least 3 years of experience managing a team or leading a significant AP process. Experience in e-commerce, retail, FMCG, or another high-volume transaction environment is preferred. Experience in Oracle ERP implementation, stabilization, enhancement, or process transformation will be an advantage. 
 CA candidates are preferred 
 How to apply: Share your cv to shelina.rout@bigbasket.com

About Us 
 Visit Health is a pioneering health-tech platform, founded in 2016 by BITS Pilani alumni, dedicated to making healthcare accessible, affordable, and preventive. Originated as a telemedicine platform during the 2015 Swine Flu epidemic, Visit Health has grown into an all-in-one wellness ecosystem that connects doctors, insurers, and millions of Indian families. Our services range from physical and mental wellness to OPD benefits, empowering both individuals and corporations to prioritize well-being. 
 Our Core Offerings 
 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Mental health support services for a balanced work-life experience. - Personalized Health Plans: Tailored wellness programs with fitness, meditation, and nutritional guidance. - Health Check-ups & Screenings: Preventive check-ups and vaccinations for proactive health management. - Comprehensive Wellness Programs: Designed to boost morale, productivity, and holistic employee health. - Preventive & OPD Care: Seamless primary care and OPD services, reducing out-of-pocket expenses through cashless OPD benefits. 
 Founding Team 
 The founding team - Chetan Anand, Anurag Prasad, Vaibhav Singh, and Shashvat Tripathi - established Visit Health to bridge the healthcare gap in India. Driven by their experiences with limited healthcare access in Pilani, they have built Visit Health into a platform that advocates quality, accessible healthcare for everyone. 
 What Sets Us Apart 
 - Comprehensive & Flexible OPD Benefits: Visit offers unlimited access packages for employees and dependents, covering mental health, nutrition, diagnostics, and doctor consultations. - Integrated Platform: Combining primary and secondary care, our platform connects corporates, insurers, and retailers, making healthcare seamless and holistic. - Engagement & Gamification: AI-driven insights, step challenges, and rewards (FitCoins) drive high engagement and builds lasting healthy habits. - 24/7 Accessibility: Accessible health support anytime, designed to address India s diverse healthcare needs. 
 Key Milestones & Achievements 
 - Expanding Primary Care Access: Serving over 5 million users with 1.5 million annual health checkups, 500,000 doctor consultations, and 200,000 pharmacy orders. - Strategic Partnerships: Collaborations with leading insurers and doctors, reaching 2,500 major Indian corporations and MSMEs. - Technological Innovation: Introduced India s first cashless OPD insurance program in partnership with Apollo Munich, with a network of over 35,000 doctors. - Awards & Recognition: Honored in Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia (2020) and BITSAA Global 30 Under 30 (2022). - Funding Success: Secured over $40 million in investments to drive growth and service expansion. 
 Future Vision

 ABOUT THE ROLE: As the Order Manager, you will play a crucial role within Client Services, responsible for processing client orders efficiently and accurately. You will be responsible for day-to-day order entry processing and operations, ensuring timely turnaround and delivery of client requests. This role will report to the Order Manager, Lead / Team Lead. 
 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Responsible for complex orders from entry to completion, ensuring accuracy and timeliness throughout the process. This includes data entry, tracking due dates, assessing asset workability, and working in close collaboration with stakeholders. • Conduct thorough validation of workflows to ensure processes are efficient, effective and compliant with company and client standards and requirements. • Serve as a point of contact for Title or Project Leads, providing regular updates on order status and escalating any issues or concerns as needed. • Own setting up and coordinating projects in our proprietary cloud-based platforms for Fulfillment & Localization services. Setting up projects on ONE / SNL and Sfera and sending out work requests to the production teams. • Ensuring that files are completed on a timely manner by liaising with Production. Workability of assets and follow up with the Client on missing/erroneous assets eg: scripts, proxies. • Set up POA for all atypical projects involving other teams. description:
Job Title: Account Manager Healthcare (US Staffing) Job Summary We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Account Manager – Healthcare to manage client relationships, coordinate healthcare staffing requirements, and drive business growth across the United States. The candidate will be responsible for managing existing client accounts, understanding staffing needs, coordinating with recruitment and credentialing teams, ensuring timely fulfillment of requirements, and maintaining high levels of client satisfaction. The ideal candidate should have experience in US healthcare staffing, client relationship management, account management, and healthcare recruitment coordination. Roles and Responsibilities Manage and maintain strong relationships with US healthcare clients, hospitals, healthcare facilities, nursing homes, and staffing partners. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts and address client requirements, concerns, and escalations. Understand client staffing needs and communicate job requirements, qualifications, shift preferences, pay rates, and assignment details to recruitment teams. Coordinate with healthcare recruiters to ensure timely submission of qualified candidates for open positions. Manage end-to-end account coordination, from receiving client requirements to candidate submission, interview scheduling, selection, onboarding, and assignment follow-up. Monitor recruitment delivery performance and ensure staffing requirements are fulfilled within agreed timelines. Coordinate with credentialing and compliance teams to track licenses, certifications, background checks, and other required candidate documentation. Follow up with clients regarding candidate submissions, interview feedback, selection decisions, and new staffing requirements. Build and maintain long-term client relationships to improve account retention, satisfaction, and repeat business. Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts by understanding client workforce needs and offering suitable staffing solutions. Coordinate with internal operations, recruitment, credentialing, payroll, and compliance teams to resolve client-related issues. Negotiate bill rates, pay rates, contract terms, and service expectations within approved company guidelines. Monitor account performance, revenue contribution, fulfillment rates, and client satisfaction metrics. Maintain accurate records of client requirements, candidate submissions, account activities, and business updates in the CRM or ATS. Prepare regular account performance reports, client updates, and business review presentations for management. Handle escalations related to staffing shortages, candidate dropouts, assignment changes, credentialing delays, and client service concerns. Support contract renewals, account expansion, and client retention initiatives. Stay updated on US healthcare staffing trends, workforce demands, and client hiring requirements. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Marketing, or a related field. Experience in US healthcare staffing, account management, client relationship management, or healthcare recruitment coordination. Strong understanding of US healthcare staffing processes and clinical job requirements. Knowledge of healthcare roles, including Registered Nurses (RNs), Licensed Practical Nurses (LPNs), Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), and allied health professionals. Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with recruitment, credentialing, operations, and client teams. Strong problem-solving, follow-up, and escalation-management skills. Familiarity with CRM platforms, ATS systems, Microsoft Excel, and account reporting tools. Ability to manage multiple client accounts and staffing requirements simultaneously. Strong customer service orientation and a focus on account growth and client satisfaction. Preferred Experience 3–7 years of experience in US healthcare staffing or healthcare account management. Prior experience managing US hospitals, healthcare facilities, nursing homes, or healthcare staffing agency accounts. Experience coordinating travel nursing, per diem, contract, and permanent healthcare staffing requirements. Understanding of client contracts, bill rates, pay rates, service-level agreements, and staffing margins. Experience in account retention, client expansion, and revenue growth. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Client satisfaction and account retention. Number of staffing requirements received and fulfilled. Requirement fulfillment rate and time-to-fill. Candidate submission-to-interview and interview-to-placement conversion rates. Revenue generated and account growth. Contract renewals and repeat business. Timely resolution of client escalations. Credentialing coordination and onboarding completion. Achievement of account-level business targets. Accuracy and timeliness of account reports and client updates. description:
We are seeking a senior Technical Writer with Documentation Architect or Systems Analyst experience to design and drive the next generation of technical documentation through AI, automation, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) integration. This role will be responsible for defining and implementing scalable documentation processes that transform engineering artifacts, including epics, user stories, pull requests, code changes, architecture decisions, testing outputs, and release data, into high-quality documentation assets and authoring-ready content. The successful candidate will act as a bridge between Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Publications, ensuring that valuable information created throughout the development process is captured, structured, and leveraged effectively. By combining documentation expertise, systems thinking, and AI-assisted workflows, this role will empower technical writers to focus on accuracy, clarity, and user value while reducing manual information gathering and content creation efforts. The role also includes working partly as a technical writer in our XML/DITA-based content management system with existing processes to get a better understanding of the authoring needs. Key Responsibilities Design and evolve documentation processes that integrate with the software development lifecycle. Define strategies for collecting, structuring, and reusing information from tools such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, CI/CD pipelines, testing systems, and architecture repositories. Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to generate documentation drafts, release notes, feature descriptions, and other documentation assets. Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, QA, DevOps, and Technical Publications teams to establish documentation requirements and information flows. Create roadmaps and implementation plans for documentation automation initiatives. Define governance, quality standards, and validation processes for AI-generated content. Analyze existing documentation workflows and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, consistency, and scalability. Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of documentation and knowledge-management tooling. Establish metrics to measure documentation quality, coverage, automation effectiveness, and content reuse. Required Qualifications Experience in Technical Writing, Technical Communication, Systems Analysis, Knowledge Management, or a related field. Strong understanding of software development processes, including Agile methodologies, source control, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. Experience working with Git-based repositories and collaborating with software engineering teams. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex systems and design scalable processes. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Familiarity with AI-assisted content generation and automation technologies. Experience translating technical concepts into clear, structured documentation. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Docs-as-Code practices and documentation automation. Understanding of APIs, software architecture, and modern development workflows. Experience working with Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, Confluence, or similar platforms. Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI governance principles. Experience leading process transformation initiatives across multiple teams. What Success Looks Like Documentation creation is proactively driven by development activities rather than manual information gathering. Technical writers spend more time refining and validating content and less time collecting information. AI-generated drafts provide reliable, high-quality starting points for documentation deliverables. Documentation coverage, consistency, and timeliness improve without increasing authoring effort. title: Assistant Finance Manager
description:
Shiksha Finance

 Job Description 
 Department: Finance & Accounts 

 Job Purpose 
The Assistant Manager Finance is responsible for managing financial accounting, statutory and regulatory compliance, audits, MIS reporting, cash flow management, and treasury operations within an NBFC framework. The role ensures accurate financial reporting, timely closures, RBI compliance, and effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 

 1. Statutory & Tax Compliance 
 Ensure timely preparation and filing of GST returns , TDS returns , and related reconciliations. Monitor amendments in tax laws applicable to NBFCs and ensure compliance. Coordinate with tax consultants and handle departmental queries. 
 2. RBI & NBFC Regulatory Reporting 
 Prepare, review, and submit RBI returns , including DNBS returns and other applicable regulatory filings. Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, NBFC prudential norms , and reporting requirements. Maintain documentation for RBI inspections and regulatory audits. 
 3. Accounts Management & Books Closure 
 Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual books closure as per AS / applicable Framework. Review journal entries, ledger balances, provisions, and reconciliations. Ensure accurate recognition of income, expenses, and provisions specific to NBFC operations. 4. Audit Coordination & Closure 
 Coordinate Internal Audit and Statutory Audit activities. Provide audit data, resolve observations, and ensure timely closure of audit points. Assist in implementation of internal control improvements. 
 5. Financial Statements & Reporting 
 Prepare Periodical financial statements including Balance Sheet, Statement of Profit & Loss, Cash Flow Statement, and Notes to Accounts. Ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance of financial disclosures. Support management in financial analysis and decision-making. 
 6. MIS & Investor Reporting 
 Prepare Monthly Management MIS and Investor MIS including portfolio performance, income analysis, and cost tracking. Perform variance analysis and present insights to senior management. Support budgeting and forecasting activities. 
 7. Cash Flow, Treasury & Billing 
 Prepare and monitor cash flow statements and liquidity position. Manage treasury operations , fund utilization, and bank relationships. Oversee billing, disbursements, and collections to ensure optimal cash management. 
 8. Debt & Repayment Management 
 Track borrowings, debt repayment schedules , interest servicing, and covenant compliance. Ensure timely repayment of loans and statutory dues. Liaise with lenders, banks, and financial institutions. 





 9. Team Handling & Coordination 
 Supervise and guide finance executives and accounts staff. Review work outputs, ensure adherence to timelines, and maintain process discipline. Support training, performance monitoring, and team development initiatives.

 Thy Designers and Computers is a growing enterprise engaged in printing services, designing

 2. Job Title

 3. Job Summary 
 The Accountant will be responsible for day-to-day accounting operations including 
 passing accounting entries, maintaining vouchers and supporting documents, managing accounts 
 receivable and payable, and supporting GST and TDS compliance activities. The role requires 
 accuracy, discipline, and a practical understanding of accounting processes in a business

 4. Key Responsibilities 
 4.1 Daily Accounting Tasks 
 Pass accounting entries accurately in accounting software (Tally or equivalent ERP system) 
 Record purchase entries with proper vendor details, invoice references, and GST classification 
 Record sales entries with correct customer details, invoice numbers, and applicable tax rates Enter bank transactions including receipts, payments, transfers, and bank charges 
Maintain clear and descriptive narrations for every accounting entry to ensure auditability 
Verify supporting documents before passing any entry 
Reconcile daily entries with source documents for accuracy 
 4.2 Voucher Management

 Purchase vouchers with proper supporting bills, delivery challans, and approvals 
 Sales vouchers with invoice copies and dispatch details 
 Bank vouchers with bank statements, deposit slips, and transfer confirmations 
 Payment vouchers with vendor bills, approval notes, and proof of payment 
 Receipt vouchers with customer remittance details and acknowledgements 
 4.3 Purchase and Sales Documentation

 4.4 Accounts Receivable and Payable Management 
 Follow up with debtors for timely collection of outstanding payments

 Prepare and maintain age-wise debtor reports (ageing analysis) on a weekly and monthly basis 
 Prepare and maintain age-wise creditor reports for cash flow planning 
 Escalate overdue accounts to the reporting authority with supporting details

 4.5 Compliance Responsibilities (GST and TDS)

description:
Description The Key Account Manager will be responsible for developing and executing account strategies for key corporate hospitals and institutions. The role involves driving business growth through value-based selling, strengthening relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring customer satisfaction, and delivering sales objectives while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations. Essential Functions Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned key hospitals and corporate accounts. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets within the assigned territory. Drive business growth by identifying new hospital opportunities and expanding existing business. Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), Key Business Leaders (KBLs), hospital administrators, purchase teams, pharmacists, microbiologists, intensivists, infectious disease specialists, anaesthesiologists, and other stakeholders. Understand customer needs, competitor activities, and market dynamics to increase product adoption. Develop conversion strategies for new product introductions and institutional business. Manage large corporate accounts and monitor account performance to maximize business potential. Conduct regular account reviews and implement corrective actions wherever required. Build state-wise sales forecasts to achieve budgeted targets. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by addressing customer concerns and improving service delivery. Promote Amneals product differentiators to create strong brand recall. Maintain accurate CRM records and update the Must-See List (MSL) regularly. Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, Fice, and other internal stakeholders to execute business plans effectively. Ensure compliance with all company policies and industry regulations while interacting with healthcare professionals and commercial entities. Additional Responsibilities Analyze account performance and recommend business improvement initiatives. Track KPIs and monitor account effectiveness. Participate in sales meetings, training programs, product launches, and developmental initiatives. Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and an entrepreneurial mindset in delivering business objectives. Qualifications Bachelors Degree in Science (B.Sc., Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or equivalent). MBA preferred. Strong understanding of institutional selling and hospital business. Knowledge of Anti-infective, Critical Care, and Hospital portfolio will be preferred. Education Bachelors Degree in Science or equivalent. MBA (Preferred). Experience Minimum 4+ years of successful experience in hospital pharmaceutical sales. Proven experience in managing Corporate Hospitals and Institutional Key Accounts . Experience in High-End Antibiotics, Anti-infectives, Critical Care, or related specialty portfolio preferred. Demonstrated experience in developing strategic customer relationships. Experience working in cross-functional environments. Strong track record of delivering sales growth and business expansion. title: AGM / DGM - Accounts & Finance (MALE Candidates)
description:
Role & responsibilities A. Financial Accounting & Reporting Oversee day-to-day accounting operations across all cinema units and Head Office. Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closures. Prepare and review Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, cash-flow statements, and financial MIS. Consolidate unit-wise financial performance and submit reports to senior management. Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, and provisions. Monitor outstanding balances, reconciliations, and inter-unit transactions. B. Cinema Unit Accounts & Revenue Monitoring Monitor daily box-office collections and reconcile ticketing-system reports with actual collections and bank deposits. Reconcile online ticketing collections, payment gateway settlements, and booking-platform commissions. Review revenue from Food & Beverage (F&B), advertising, screen rentals, and other ancillary activities. Ensure proper accounting of movie distributor settlements, film rental charges, and applicable revenue-sharing arrangements. Monitor complimentary tickets, discounts, refunds, cancellations, and other revenue adjustments. Conduct periodic financial reviews of individual cinema units and investigate variances. C. Budgeting, MIS & Cost Control Prepare annual budgets, operating budgets, and periodic financial forecasts. Develop unit-wise and screen-wise profitability reports. Analyse revenue, EBITDA, operating costs, and budget variances. Monitor major operating expenses, including electricity, manpower, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and consumables. Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality or statutory compliance. Prepare management dashboards highlighting financial performance, risks, and corrective actions. D. Commercial Purchase & Vendor Management Review purchase transactions, vendor invoices, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Ensure adherence to purchase policies, approval matrices, and budgetary limits. Monitor vendor payments, outstanding balances, advances, and debit or credit notes. Review vendor contracts, payment terms, and commercial implications. Coordinate with Purchase and Operations teams to control expenditure and prevent unauthorised spending. E. Statutory Compliance & Taxation Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS, income tax, and other statutory requirements. Oversee GST reconciliations, tax returns, and input tax credit verification. Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities. Ensure proper maintenance of accounting records, tax documentation, and audit trails. Monitor compliance with applicable accounting standards and financial regulations. F. Internal Controls & Audit Establish and strengthen financial controls across all cinema locations. Ensure proper segregation of duties for collections, cash handling, accounting, and payment processing. Conduct periodic reviews of cash, bank, inventory, fixed assets, and vendor balances. Investigate financial irregularities, revenue leakages, duplicate payments, and unexplained variances. Coordinate internal and statutory audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations. Implement corrective measures to prevent recurring control failures. G. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management Monitor daily cash positions, bank balances, collections, and payment obligations. Prepare cash-flow forecasts and fund requirement statements. Ensure timely collection of receivables and settlement of vendor dues. Optimise working capital and monitor outstanding advances. Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for routine banking activities. H. Fixed Assets & Capital Expenditure Maintain oversight of fixed asset registers and capital expenditure accounting. Monitor cinema equipment, projection systems, sound systems, seating, HVAC, electrical installations, and other infrastructure assets. Review capital expenditure proposals against approved budgets. Ensure proper capitalisation, depreciation, asset verification, and disposal accounting. Monitor project costs for new cinema openings, renovations, and screen upgrades. I. Team Management & Process Improvement Lead, guide, and review the performance of the Accounts team at Head Office and cinema units. Establish standard operating procedures for unit accounting and financial reporting. Ensure timely submission of unit accounts, reconciliations, and MIS. Train team members on accounting processes, compliance, and internal controls. Improve accounting efficiency through automation, standardisation, and effective use of ERP and MIS tools. 
 Preferred candidate profile Qualifications & Experience CA / CMA preferred; alternatively, CA Inter, M.Com, MBA Finance, or an equivalent qualification with relevant experience. Approximately 1015 years of relevant experience for AGM/DGM-level positions, depending on organisational structure and role complexity. Experience in multi-unit operations, retail, hospitality, entertainment, multiplexes, or other high-volume transaction businesses is preferred. Strong knowledge of financial accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, audit, and MIS. Key Competencies Financial discipline and accountability. Analytical thinking and attention to detail. Cost consciousness and commercial decision-making. Integrity and confidentiality. Team leadership and process orientation. Proactive identification and resolution of financial risks.

The role is critical in ensuring consistency in revenue tracking, billing alignment, and revenue recognition across diverse service lines and systems.

You’ll establish and govern a single source of truth for revenue by maintaining a central tracker, aligning CRM, billing, and finance systems, and ensuring consistent revenue capture, classification, and accountability across teams. You’ll ensure billing accuracy and proper revenue recognition by partnering with finance operations, monitoring unbilled revenue and pipeline conversion, and identifying risks such as revenue leakage, delays, or contract misalignment.  OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE 
We are seeking a technically proficient Finance EPM ARCS Senior Analyst to manage the technical configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of our ARCS environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Oracle EPM ARCS with experience in ARCS development projects, system administration, data integration, and technical support. The successful candidate will ensure that current requirements continue to be met and will be responsible for incremental development work. KEY RESPONSIBILITES Manage, configure, and maintain Oracle EPM ARCS (Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching module), including formats, profiles, reconciliations, match types, data loads, user access, security settings, and mapping rules. Develop and maintain data integrations between ARCS and other financial systems, ensuring accurate and timely data flow. Develop and maintain ARCS reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide visibility into reconciliation status. Perform routine system maintenance, including data loads, data validations, and system backups, to ensure data integrity and system stability. Troubleshoot and resolve ARCS technical issues, providing hands-on support to end-users as needed. Monitor system performance and conduct root cause analysis for technical issues. Provide technical guidance to project teams and end-users, assisting with complex technical configurations and customizations. Work closely with functional teams to identify opportunities for system enhancements, process automation, and optimization. Document technical configurations, processes, and troubleshooting guides, maintaining a knowledge base for internal use. Stay updated with Oracle EPM ARCS updates and new features, making recommendations for system improvements and upgrades. Deliver training and support to end-users and project teams, creating documentation and promoting smooth adoption of ARCS functionalities. Collaboration with stakeholders Bridge the gap between business requirements and technical specifications, ensuring effective communication and understanding. Support users within the EPM community and across the wider business, enabling efficient utilization of EPM functionalities. Collaborate actively with the Finance teams across the Group to identify and implement continuous process and system improvements, driving our business initiatives forward. Support system training programs and conduct training sessions for global business users. Play an active role in mentoring and developing junior team members, fostering excellence and expanding our knowledge base. TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field 5+ years of hands-on experience in deployment and support of Oracle EPM ARCS processes Proven experience with design, configuration, and administration of Oracle EPM Cloud ARCS solutions. Proven experience with both ARCS modules: Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching. Experience in EPM Data Management / Data Exchange. Experience with data integrations tools (ODI, OIC), SQL and relational databases. Experience in EPM Automate / EPM REST APIs. Experience on other EPM modules (EDM, FCCS, TRCS, ARCS, or Narrative Reporting) is a plus. Proactive and innovative approach, constantly looking for chances to enhance processes and supporting management in their implementation. Motivated to learn new technologies and expand your functional and technical expertise to other Oracle EPM Cloud products. Oracle EPM Cloud certification is a plus. BENEFITS WE OFFER Access to Learnerbly, Udemy , and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling. Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs . Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents. Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year. Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness. Hybrid Model : 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals. Free Meals, Cab Allowance , and a Home Office Setup Allowance. Employer PF Contribution , gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance. Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares. Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections. Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards . WHY CHOOSE US Flutter is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. title: Hiring for-Senior Accountant, Financial Close and Reconciliation-BNGLR
description:
Greetings from Infosys BPM Ltd., 
 We are hiring for Senior Accountant, Financial Close and Reconciliations Domain for Bangalore. 
 Please find below Job Description for your reference: 
 Job Location: Bengaluru Qualification: Degree in Accounting (Full Time) Total years of Experience: 6-8 Years relevant experience Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days Only Shift: Flexible to work for any shift Work From Office is mandatory. Type: Individual contributor; preparer role only. 
 Note : we are looking for Accounting and Close. 
 Role Summary: 
 The Senior Accountant, Financial Close and Reconciliations prepares bank, balance sheet, and subledger reconciliations, tie-outs, close workpapers, and journal entry packages, and supports the external audit. 
 Most reconciling items clear. The ones that do not are where the role earns its value: an item that keeps rolling forward, a variance that is small but persistent, or a balance that ties but for the wrong reason. The role is expected to investigate the root cause rather than plug the difference, and to explain the item plainly. These are the cases the role exists to get right. 
 This is a preparer role only. Approval, posting, sign-off, and all accounting-policy judgement are retained by, preserving segregation of duties. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Reconciliations: 
 Prepare bank, balance sheet, and subledger reconciliations to the close calendar, including card settlement and customer funds accounts. Investigate and explain reconciling items, and track aged items to resolution. Escalate unresolved or unusual items with a clear explanation. Month-End Close: 
 Prepare tie-outs and close workpapers. Prepare journal entry packages with supporting documentation for review and posting. Meet close calendar deadlines and flag risks early. 
 Audit Support: 
 Prepare schedules and supporting documentation for external audit requests. Respond to auditor queries promptly and accurately. 
 Process Improvement: 
 Identify recurring reconciling items and recommend fixes at source. Standardise and automate reconciliation workpapers where practical. 
 Experience & Qualifications: 
 Level and Tenure: 
 Intermediate, upper band Process Associate to Manager (PAM). 6+ years of accounting experience, including reconciliations and month-end close. CPA designation or progress toward it, or equivalent accounting qualification. 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 Extensive experience preparing reconciliations and close workpapers. Strong Excel skills. Working knowledge of IFRS. Root-cause discipline: investigates unexplained differences rather than plugging them. Assessed at interview through a case exercise. High attention to detail. 
 Preferred: 
 NetSuite experience. Payments or card settlement accounting experience. Experience with a reconciliation automation tool. Financial services or fintech experience.

title: Account Executive  (Taxation And  Audit Compliance)
description:
About ShipDelight ShipDelight Logistics Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a technology-driven logistics company operating across 4PL Logistics, B2B Logistics, and SaaS-based logistics intelligence through Instalogix. We work with multiple logistics partners and business clients, supported by technology-enabled processes and a growing business ecosystem. Job Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented and hands-on Account Executive Taxation & Audit Compliance to manage GST, TDS, statutory filings, tax reconciliations, audit coordination, and related accounting activities. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate statutory compliance across the company's business verticals. The role requires practical knowledge of taxation, the ability to independently execute routine compliance activities, and effective coordination with internal teams and external Chartered Accountants. This is an individual contributor role with direct responsibility for execution, accuracy, documentation, and compliance deadlines. It does not involve team management. Key Responsibilities 1. GST Compliance Prepare and file periodic GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. Reconcile purchase registers with GSTR-2B and identify missing invoices, mismatches, and input tax credit discrepancies. Reconcile GST output liability, input tax credit, books of accounts, and filed returns. Coordinate with vendors, customers, and internal teams to resolve GST discrepancies. Review the applicable GST treatment of logistics services, courier-related transactions, B2B billing, and SaaS invoices in coordination with the reporting manager or tax advisor. Assist in preparing annual GST returns and reconciliation statements, wherever applicable. Track GST notices, portal communications, and outstanding compliance matters. 
 2. TDS and Income Tax Compliance Calculate TDS on applicable payments and ensure timely deduction and deposit. Prepare and file applicable quarterly TDS returns, including Forms 24Q and 26Q. Reconcile TDS payable, challans, filed returns, and accounting ledgers. Verify TDS credits and assist in resolving discrepancies. Support advance tax workings and other assigned income-tax compliance activities. Track statutory due dates and relevant tax amendments. 
 3. Statutory Audit and Tax Audit Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants and auditors for statutory audits, tax audits, and other applicable audits. Prepare audit schedules, ledger extracts, reconciliations, and supporting documents. Respond to routine audit queries and follow up on pending observations. Maintain organized records of tax returns, challans, invoices, workings, and compliance documents. Assist with year-end closing and preparation of tax-related financial schedules. 
 4. Business-Vertical Taxation Handle taxation and compliance activities covering ShipDelight's 4PL Logistics, B2B Logistics, and SaaS (Instalogix) businesses. Maintain business-vertical-wise reconciliations and tax workings wherever required. Coordinate with Accounts, Operations, Onboarding, and other relevant teams to resolve transaction-related discrepancies. Verify tax-related information for vendor and customer transactions. Identify compliance risks and escalate complex interpretations or material issues to the reporting manager or external tax advisor. 
 5. Accounting and Compliance Management Maintain accurate statutory liability ledgers and supporting accounting records. Prepare compliance calendars and monitor filing and payment deadlines. Perform periodic ledger scrutiny and statutory reconciliations. Maintain a centralized repository of tax and audit documentation. Support monthly and annual financial closing activities related to taxation. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and completeness of financial records. 
 Mandatory Skills and Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience in taxation, GST, TDS, and audit compliance. Hands-on experience preparing and filing GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. Practical experience reconciling GSTR-2B with purchase registers. Working knowledge of TDS calculations, challan payments, quarterly returns, and reconciliation. Experience coordinating with external auditors or Chartered Accountants. Strong understanding of accounting principles, ledger scrutiny, and statutory liability reconciliation. Proficiency in MS Excel, including lookup functions, PivotTables, and reconciliation worksheets. Working knowledge of the GST portal, Income Tax e-filing portal, and accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books, or equivalent ERP systems. 
 Preferred Qualifications and Experience B.Com mandatory; M.Com or CA Inter preferred. Experience in a logistics, services, technology, SaaS, or multi-business-vertical organization will be an advantage. Experience independently managing routine compliance activities with minimal supervision. Strong documentation, coordination, analytical, and deadline-management skills. 
 Key Performance Expectations Timely filing of applicable statutory returns and payment of dues. Accurate GST and TDS calculations and reconciliations. Timely resolution of tax mismatches and outstanding compliance items. Timely submission of audit schedules and supporting documents. Proper maintenance of statutory records and compliance trackers. Proactive identification and escalation of compliance risks. Minimization of avoidable interest, late fees, and penalties attributable to processing errors or missed deadlines. 
 Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a hands-on taxation professional who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, can independently manage routine GST and TDS compliance, prepares audit documentation, and works effectively with internal stakeholders and external auditors. Candidates whose experience is limited to data entry or assisting senior accountants without independently handling compliance activities may not be suitable. 
 Candidates should mention their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant taxation experience while applying.
