Understand customer concerns clearly and provide accurate, relevant and timely responses. Resolve customer issues at the first point of contact wherever possible. Demonstrate empathy, patience and professionalism while dealing with customers. Handle difficult, escalated or sensitive customer interactions in a calm and solution-oriented manner. Ensure that every customer interaction reflects Skechers commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience. 2. Issue Resolution & Internal Coordination Coordinate with relevant internal teams such as Retail Operations, E-commerce, Warehouse, Logistics, Finance, IT and other support functions for resolution of customer concerns. Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure issues are resolved within defined timelines. Maintain ownership of customer issues until closure and avoid unnecessary hand-offs. Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the appropriate supervisor/manager. Ensure customers are kept informed about the status of their requests wherever required. 3. Build positive relationships with customers through effective communication and problem-solving. Identify recurring customer concerns and highlight trends or issues to the reporting manager. Capture customer feedback and share relevant insights with the team for service improvement. Contribute towards improving customer satisfaction and overall customer experience. 4. Understand and communicate relevant company policies and processes accurately. Guide customers on the appropriate process for resolving their concerns. Ensure all customer interactions and actions taken are accurately documented. Highlight high-priority or recurring complaints to the reporting manager for corrective action. 6. title: Supply Chain Planner
description:
Job Summary: To plan and maintain daily Supply Chain operations in one or more functional areas such as materials, production, inventory, logistics, customer service, demand management or order fulfillment. Ensures internal and external customers' expectations and requirements are met. 
 Key Responsibilities: Develop planning system strategies to improve signals across the supply chain Monitor and adjust parameters in the planning system. Use common processes tools, and information systems. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Execute the daily operational planning process within a specified functional area. Identify potential supply chain failures as part of the planning process and mitigate associated risks Work closely with stakeholders - internal and/or external to develop short term tactical improvements. Use the planning system to drive consistent planning signals across the supply chain Participate in functional process improvement teams 
 Qualifications and Competencies Competencies: 
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
 Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
 Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
 Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
 Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
 Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
 Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.
 Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc.) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
 Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
 Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customers expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.
 Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis. 
 Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
 Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

College, university, or equivalent degree required.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

title: Senior BIM Manager- (Data Center)
company: Intelligent Consulting Engineers And Builders Priv Ate
description:
Senior Manager BIM- Data Centres 
 About ICE: Intelligent Consulting Engineers (ICE) is a multidisciplinary engineering firm of around 350 people. We deliver BIM coordination, structural engineering, precast design and detailing, and rebar detailing for clients worldwide. All our design and BIM work is delivered from our offices in India. We have five offices across India and a presence in the USA, Canada, Finland, Estonia, Singapore, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Data centres are one of our biggest and fastest growing sectors. 
 The role: Lead ICE's Data Centre BIM practice and build it into a much larger, stronger team over the next two years. You will be the senior technical face of our DC BIM work. You will sit alongside BD in front of customers, and you will run the team that delivers the work. This is a hands on leadership role. You will own delivery, people and growth for the practice, and work closely with the Director of BIM Services and the leadership team. 
 Reports to : Director, BIM Services 
 Location :Noida, Pune 
 Experience: 12+ years in BIM, several data centre projects . 
 Data centres (hyperscale, colocation, enterprise) 
 What you'll do Customers and business development Back BD technically : join pre sales and sales meetings, understand what the customer needs, and explain how we will deliver it. Shape proposals : define scope, LOD, deliverables, team size and timelines, and review pricing with BD so proposals are realistic and win work. Be the senior contact : build trusted relationships with client BIM managers, design leads and project directors. Grow accounts : spot new DC BIM opportunities with existing clients and help open new ones. Delivery Oversee all DC projects : keep a clear view of every project through regular reporting, and make sure coordination, quality, schedule and budget hold. Own multidisciplinary coordination : make sure Arch, Structure, MEP and Fire models are coordinated, clash free and buildable, including dense white space, electrical and mechanical areas. Set standards : define and maintain BIM execution plans, modelling standards, QA/QC checks and templates aligned to ISO 19650 and client requirements. Handle escalations : step in quickly when a project or client relationship needs senior attention. People and team Lead and grow the team : manage the existing team, reshape it where you see fit, and hire the right people to scale. Build leaders : develop team leads and BIM coordinators who can run projects on their own. Train and upskill : set up training on DC design, coordination and tools so quality stays high as the team grows. Keep good people : create a culture where strong performers want to stay and grow. Resources and commercials Plan resources : forecast demand and allocate people across T&M and fixed fee contracts. Protect margins : track utilisation, hours against budget and project profitability, and act early when numbers slip. Improve how we work : bring in automation, Dynamo scripts, families and workflows that save time and improve output. 
 What you bring: B.Tech / B.E. in Architecture, Civil or MEP. A Master's degree or BIM certification is a plus. 12+ years in BIM, with several data centre projects delivered end to end. Strong understanding of multidisciplinary coordination (Arch, Structure, MEP, Fire) in DC BIM. Good knowledge of how data centres work: white space, power and cooling systems, containment and services routing. Hands on experience with Revit, Navisworks and BIM 360 / ACC. Dynamo knowledge is a plus. Working knowledge of ISO 19650, BEPs and LOD requirements. Proven experience leading large BIM teams and managing several projects at once. Customer facing experience with international clients, ideally in the US, Europe, Middle East or APAC. Clear communication at every level, from modellers to client leadership. An organised planner with a sharp eye for detail. A strong growth mindset and real hunger to grow in a fast moving company. 
 Why choose ICE : Build something big : you will not just manage a team, you will build a practice. As the team grows, your role and career grow with it. Work on world class data centres : deliver BIM for global hyperscaler and colocation clients across 15+ countries. Full BIM capability under one roof : we cover structure, architecture, MEP and fire, so you lead complete multidisciplinary projects, not just one trade. Global reach, India delivery : work with international clients and teams while leading delivery from India. Real ownership : a senior, visible role with direct access to leadership and the freedom to shape how the practice runs. A growing company : ICE is expanding into new markets, and data centres are at the heart of that growth. Rewarding pay : competitive salary plus an attractive incentive scheme linked to growth. 
 Ready to build what's next? Send your CV and a short summary of your DC BIM projects to career@icengg.com

As a CBS professional, you will work across teams to provide the knowledge, resources and tools that help EY deliver exceptional quality service to our clients, win in the marketplace and support EY s growth and profitability. Major teams within CBS include Finance, Information Technology, Human Resources, Enterprise Support Services, Admin, Brand, Marketing and Communications, Quality and Risk Management. We aim to develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, besides playing a critical role in building a better working world for our people, clients and communities. 
 
 Your key responsibilities

 End-user support Provide L1/L2 support for laptops, operating systems, standard workplace applications, peripherals, connectivity, printing, collaboration tools, and user access issues Receive, log, categorise, prioritise, trouble-shoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service expectations Provide hands-on and remote support, communicate progress clearly, and confirm resolution with users before closure Identify recurring issues, apply documented fixes, and escalate complex, security-related, or infrastructure issues to the appropriate support team Laptop configuration and lifecycle support Configure, image, update, and prepare laptops in line with approved build standards and security requirements. Support laptop allocation, issue, replacement, swap, return, refresh, and decommissioning activities. Install authorised software, apply standard settings, validate device readiness, and complete handover checks with users. Coordinate warranty support, repair, and vendor follow-up where required. Asset and inventory management Maintain complete and accurate laptop inventory records, including asset details, assigned user, location, device status, issue and return dates, and custody history. Perform periodic physical verification and reconcile inventory records against devices held, issued, under repair, returned, or retired. Maintain supporting documentation for device movement and user acknowledgement, and promptly report discrepancies. Ensure devices and accessories are stored, handled, and transferred in accordance with applicable asset-control and information-security procedures. Service operations and reporting Maintain clear ticket notes, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, asset updates, and supporting records. Contribute to knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, checklists, and frequently asked questions. Provide basic operational updates on ticket volumes, ageing items, recurring issues, inventory status, and open dependencies. Support onboarding, offboarding, office moves, planned technology activities, and business events as required. Skills and capabilities Practical troubleshooting knowledge across laptops, common operating systems, productivity applications, peripherals, network connectivity, and collaboration tools. Working knowledge of device configuration, software installation, patching, endpoint controls, and standard security practices. Experience using an IT service management or ticketing tool and following incident, request, escalation, and closure processes. Good understanding of IT asset inventory, device custody, reconciliation, and lifecycle documentation. Strong customer-service orientation with clear written and verbal communication. Ability to prioritise competing requests, work independently, follow defined processes, and maintain attention to detail. Ability to collaborate with users, internal technology teams, vendors, and other service partners. 
 
 Experience and qualifications 
 
 Experience 
 Relevant experience in a service desk, desktop support, field support, or end-user technology support role, including hands-on L1/L2 troubleshooting. Experience supporting laptop deployment, configuration, inventory, repair coordination, and user handover activities.

Follow approved technology, information-security, access-control, asset-management, and data-handling procedures. Maintain accurate records and demonstrate clear ownership of tickets and assigned assets through to closure. Be available to provide on-site support and reasonable coverage aligned to business operating requirements, including planned support outside standard hours when agreed. 
 
 What we look for 
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

title: Associate/Senior Associate - Service Desk Improvement
description:
Department: IT Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time Location: Pune 
 Description 
 The Associate / Senior Associate - Service Desk Improvement provides first-line support through telephone, portal, chat and email. The role records, categorises, priorities, diagnoses and resolves incidents, fulfils approved standard requests, and retains ownership of the customer experience when work is escalated. The Senior Associate operates with greater independence on complex first-line issues, supports shift handovers and quality, coaches colleagues, and contributes to knowledge and controlled shift-left. The role does not own specialist engineering, security investigation, application development or infrastructure administration unless an activity has been formally documented, trained, authorised and controlled for Service Desk fulfilment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Core responsibilities Act as a professional single point of contact for IT incidents and service requests through supported channels; verify user identity and capture the affected service, device, location, business impact and required evidence. Create, categorise and prioritise tickets accurately using agreed impact and urgency criteria; check known incidents and outages; set clear expectations and provide meaningful updates. Perform structured first-line diagnosis using approved knowledge, remote-support tools and troubleshooting methods; resolve within authorised capability and confirm restoration before closure. Fulfil approved standard requests only when required information, approvals and controls are present; route privileged, non-standard, engineering or business-approval work to the accountable team. Identify potential major incidents and security concerns promptly and engage the defined escalation process without attempting unauthorised investigation or remediation. Escalate unresolved issues with complete diagnostics, error details, screenshots/logs where appropriate, actions already taken, business impact and a clear next-step request. Retain end-to-end ownership of the customer experience after escalation by monitoring SLA position, following up with resolver teams, coordinating callbacks and confirming user acceptance before closure. Maintain high-quality work notes, resolution details, closure codes and shift handovers to support auditability, reporting, Problem Management and continual improvement. Use approved knowledge articles, identify gaps or outdated content, and create or improve draft knowledge from repeatable resolutions. Follow security, privacy, identity-verification, least-privilege and data-handling requirements always. Contribute to service measures including response, first-contact/first-line resolution, SLA compliance, aged backlog, reopen rate, misrouting, ticket quality, knowledge use and customer experience. Senior Associate: provide floor support, coach Associates, review ticket and escalation quality, support queue health and shift handover, and help validate new first-line procedures before adoption. First-line service coverage Access, identity and JML assistance: password reset, account unlock, MFA, Okta and YubiKey support; approved mailbox, distribution/security group and collaboration access; joiner support for missing access/apps; accurate routing of mover, leaver, guest, auditor and privileged-access requests. Devices and software: Windows laptop/desktop triage, peripheral and printer troubleshooting, approved application installation/removal through Company Portal, Intune or SCCM, device-build evidence capture, mobile/tablet setup and enrolment, and lost/stolen device workflow initiation. Email, collaboration and file services: Outlook, Exchange/Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, shared mailboxes, delegation, supported conferencing tools, Copilot access/standard-use triage, file sharing, removable-media requests and document-productivity tools. Connectivity and remote working: VPN, wireless, office connectivity, Citrix, client/external portal access, mobile Wi-Fi/tethering guidance and initial diagnostics for SFTP or allow-list requests before specialist routing. Meeting rooms, telephony and voice: displays, cameras, microphones, room technology, ClickShare, Teams Voice, Avaya, Genesys, digital fax, call recording, digital dictation and voice-recognition applications at first-line scope. Business and divisional applications: consistent intake, access triage, installation/add-in support where documented, outage identification and evidence-led routing to Product Support, line-of-business teams or vendors. Reporting and analytics: first-line access and client/browser diagnosis for Power BI, QlikView and SSRS; route workspace, gateway, dataset, report logic and underlying-data issues to the accountable owner. Infrastructure-generated contacts: capture user impact and correlate contacts for availability, backup/restore, cloud, database, server, network, capacity or continuity issues; specialist teams retain engineering accountability. Service boundaries Out of scope unless formally shifted left: network/firewall configuration, server provisioning or patching, database administration, cloud/VM engineering, backup-policy or disaster-recovery design, security monitoring/investigation, application development/defect correction, procurement decisions and business-process support owned by Finance, Payroll, HR or divisional teams. Unsupported, retired or vendor-owned products must be routed according to the approved application support matrix; the Service Desk must not imply technical ownership where none is assigned. Experience & Education* Associate: typically 1-5 years of relevant Service Desk, technical support or customer-facing IT support experience. Senior Associate: typically 5-9 years of relevant Service Desk experience, including independent handling of complex first-line issues, escalation quality, shift handover and peer support. Hands-on use of an ITSM tool such as ServiceNow to log, categorise, prioritise, update, resolve and close incidents and requests. Experience supporting users across Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, identity/authentication, remote working, connectivity, devices and common collaboration tools. Experience working to SLAs while maintaining accurate ticket documentation and customer communication. Education Bachelor's degree or equivalent recognised undergraduate qualification in technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Role-relevant technical training or certifications are advantageous when supported by demonstrable practical capability. 
 Skills, Knowledge & Expertise 
 Knowledge, Skill, ability Strong technical troubleshooting across Windows, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint, identity and access, MFA/Okta, VPN, Citrix, wireless, devices, peripherals, printers and approved software. Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident Management, Request Fulfilment, Knowledge Management, escalation and Major Incident identification. Ability to distinguish an incident from a request, assess impact and urgency, select the correct service/category and gather evidence that enables rapid resolver diagnosis. Customer-focused communication: active listening, clear language, expectation management, ownership and professional handling of high-impact or frustrated-user situations. Ability to follow documented procedures and security controls, including identity verification, data handling, approvals and least privilege. Good written documentation with concise work notes, reproducible diagnostic steps, resolution details and effective handovers. Ability to manage competing priorities during high-volume periods, work collaboratively across global resolver teams and adapt to rotational shifts. Associate: demonstrates learning agility, procedural discipline and readiness to broaden technical coverage. Senior Associate: demonstrates sound judgement, coaching capability, queue awareness, quality focus and confidence challenging incomplete or incorrect routing without losing customer ownership. Essential requirement (non-negotiable) * Hands-on Service Desk or equivalent first-line technical/customer support experience at the appropriate Associate or Senior Associate level. Demonstrated first-line troubleshooting capability across core workplace technology and authentication/connectivity issues. Excellent spoken and written communication with evidence of customer ownership and accurate expectation setting. Ability to work through approved rotational shifts supporting global operations from office location only. Proven ability to work to SLAs, maintain high-quality ticket records and escalate with complete diagnostic evidence. Commitment to security, privacy, identity verification, least privilege and approved procedures. Willingness to use and improve knowledge and to learn new services as controlled shift-left is introduced. Certification if any: Preferred: ITIL 4 Foundation. title: Product Manager (Direct Procurement)
description:
Job Description Role Overview As the Product Manager for Distribution, you are the "Full-Stack" owner of the value stream connecting our suppliers to our customers. You will move beyond tactical ticket-writing to drive the "Why" and "What" for both customer sales and supplier purchasing capabilities. This role is part of our Functional Product Stream, focused on solving pervasive market problems to drive adoption and revenue. Core Responsibilities Your work is structured around the Product Management Lifecycle (PMLC), focusing on outcome-based decision gates rather than feature output. 1. Discovery & Strategy (The "Why") Market Sensing: Conduct biweekly customer and supplier interactions to validate that identified problems are urgent and pervasive. Problem Validation: Use data from Win/Loss reports and Customer Advisory Boards (CAB) to build evidence-based business cases. Opportunity Canvasing: Define the market driver, competitive landscape, and economic impact (ROI) for new distribution initiatives. 2. Solution & Design (The "What") Roadmap Ownership: Maintain a 3-year Now/Next/Later roadmap that balances customer sales features, supplier integration, and technical health. Ruthless Prioritization: Apply the RICE framework (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort) to the backlog to ensure we focus on "Return on Effort". Constraint Definition: Clearly distinguish between MVP (Technical Prototype) and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) to prevent scope creep. 3. Delivery & Market Alignment (The "How") Squad Leadership: Act as the strategic lead for a group of Autonomous Squads (Atomic Scrum Units), collaborating with a Tech Lead and Product Designer. GTM Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing to ensure Sales, Support, and Customer Success are operationally ready for new releases. Success Analysis: Post-launch, measure actual adoption and revenue against the original business case metrics to decide whether to Pivot, Persevere, or Kill. 4.Success Metrics (KPIs) In a product-led organization, you are measured on Outcomes, not outputs: ARR: Supporting growth goals for sales. Customer Retention: Ensuring users get continuous value from the distribution module. Outcome Achievement: Meeting the specific success criteria defined in your Business Cases (e.g., reducing purchasing lead times). Strategic Alignment: Ensuring 100% of your roadmap items are scalable for multiple customers and not bespoke requests. Qualifications Experience: 5-10 years of experience in Product Management within supply chain, ERP, or distribution software is highly preferred. Mindset: High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural curiosity for user problems over technical "purity". Decision Making: Ability to make "Green Light" investment recommendations based on hard data (logs, usage stats) rather than "gut feel". Tooling: Proficiency in Aha! for strategy/roadmapping and Jira for execution management.

Strong expertise in supplier identification, evaluation, selection, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management. Experience in cost optimisation, Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE), should-cost modelling, and design-to-cost initiatives. Supply Chain Management certifications. Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certifications. Value Engineering and Cost Optimisation certifications. Project or Program Management certifications. Detailed Job Description Role Overview The Head Supply Chain Management (Sheet Metal) will lead strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier development, cost optimisation, and supply chain operations for sheet metal components and Body-in-White (BIW) assemblies within the automotive manufacturing environment. The role involves developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier relationships, driving cost reduction initiatives, and ensuring supplier readiness for new product development and mass production. The individual will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to ensure cost competitiveness, product quality, timely component availability, and uninterrupted manufacturing operations. Strategic Sourcing and Procurement Develop and execute sourcing strategies for BIW assemblies, fabricated parts, sheet metal components, structural reinforcements, cross-members, brackets, mounting structures, and related subassemblies. Lead supplier identification, evaluation, selection, negotiations, contracting, and ongoing performance management. Drive sourcing activities for sheet metal, steel grades, high-strength steel, aluminium structures, stampings, laser-cut parts, welded assemblies, and fabricated components. Establish competitive sourcing strategies through localisation, dual sourcing, make-versus-buy analysis, and supplier consolidation. Negotiate long-term supply agreements, commodity contracts, tooling costs, capacity commitments, and commercial terms. Develop sourcing strategies that balance cost competitiveness, quality, delivery performance, supplier capability, and supply chain resilience. Cost Optimisation and Value Engineering Drive annual cost reduction initiatives through Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE), design-to-cost, should-cost modelling, strategic negotiations, and process improvements. Optimise material utilisation, scrap levels, production yield, tooling investments, logistics costs, and supplier conversion costs. Collaborate with Engineering teams to reduce BIW weight and component costs without compromising structural integrity, safety, durability, or manufacturability. Establish cost benchmarks for raw materials, fabricated components, welding assemblies, and tooling. Monitor commodity price movements and implement appropriate cost-management strategies. Identify opportunities for supplier productivity improvement, material cost reduction, and total cost of ownership optimisation. Supplier Development and Industrialisation Build, develop, and manage a competitive supplier ecosystem for BIW components, sheet metal parts, and fabricated assemblies. Lead supplier capability assessments covering stamping, press tools, laser cutting, CNC machining, robotic welding, fixture design, dimensional control, and assembly processes. Drive supplier capacity planning, process validation, production readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure supplier readiness across prototype, pilot production, and mass-production phases. Establish strategic supplier partnerships to support localisation, manufacturing innovation, and future product platforms. Monitor supplier performance against quality, cost, delivery, capacity, and operational excellence targets. Work with suppliers to resolve capability gaps, manufacturing bottlenecks, and production-related challenges. New Product Development and Program Management Lead sourcing activities from concept and prototype stages through engineering validation, production validation, and Start of Production (SOP). Ensure supplier nomination, tooling development, sample approvals, process validation, and capacity readiness are aligned with program milestones. Participate in cross-functional reviews covering design freeze, engineering changes, Bill of Materials (BOM) cost, tooling status, and launch readiness. Ensure timely resolution of supplier-related issues during prototype builds, production trials, and manufacturing ramp-up. Integrate supplier risk assessments and sourcing decisions into product development and launch plans. Coordinate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers to ensure smooth program execution and timely launch. Track sourcing deliverables, tooling timelines, component approvals, and supplier readiness against program schedules. Supply Planning and Operational Excellence Ensure uninterrupted supply of BIW components and sheet metal parts to manufacturing facilities. Lead demand planning, material planning, inventory optimisation, supplier scheduling, and logistics coordination. Establish appropriate inventory strategies for long-lead-time tooling, imported materials, critical components, and production ramp-ups. Drive improvements in On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance, lead times, inventory turns, schedule adherence, and supply continuity. Develop and implement contingency plans to manage capacity constraints, supplier disruptions, and raw-material shortages. Collaborate with manufacturing and logistics teams to align supply plans with production requirements. Establish performance monitoring mechanisms to identify supply risks and drive corrective actions. Key Deliverables Competitive sourcing strategies and improved procurement performance for sheet metal and BIW components. Achievement of annual cost reduction and VA/VE targets. Development of a robust and capable supplier ecosystem. Timely supplier nomination, tooling development, and production readiness for new product programs. Improved supplier quality, delivery performance, and manufacturing capability. Effective inventory management and uninterrupted supply to manufacturing operations. Successful coordination of sourcing and supplier-related milestones through SOP. Reduced supply chain risks, improved operational efficiency, and stronger supplier partnerships. description:
Role: Revenue Management
Level: Senior Manager/ Associate Director
Location: Gurugram Reporting To: Vice President 

 About the function:

 The Hotels business at MakeMyTrip is one of the largest and fastest-growing verticals within
the organization, driving exceptional travel experiences for millions of customers every year.
With a strong focus on customer delight, technology-led innovation, and deep partnerships,
the Hotels team curates and manages an extensive portfolio of domestic and international
stays across leisure and business destinations. The function works closely with supply
partners, revenue management, marketing, product, and operations teams to ensure the right
balance of availability, pricing, and quality, delivering unmatched value to travelers while
strengthening partner relationships.
Within this, the International Hotels team expertly manages the supply portfolio of over
17,000 prestigious hotels across the globe, covering iconic travel destinations such as the
UAE, Maldives, Sri Lanka, Bali, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Europe, and many others. This
team is responsible for building, nurturing, and optimizing relationships with global hotel
partners to ensure competitive pricing, seamless inventory integration, and differentiated
experiences for our customers.

 About the role:
This is a strategic role for a leader who will shape the growth agenda of the International
Hotels business at MMT. The role owns the revenue strategy and manages the P&L end to
end, turning market, supply and customer insights into clear growth bets. It works closely
with the customer insights and marketing teams to plan and run large-scale sales campaigns,
and partners with supply, product and leadership teams to grow market share, conversion
and profitability across our key international destinations.

 What will you be doing: 
 P&L Management & Driving Growth: 
Define and drive the short-term and long-term growth agenda of the business
while influencing various cross-functional teams.
Manage the business's P&L and devise strategies to achieve revenue goals for the online
channel.
Tactically manage active revenue levers to attain daily margin, conversion, and transaction
goals.
Lead discussions on relevant alliances, execute tactical marketing campaigns, and
finalize traffic planning for the upcoming quarter.
Track performance parameters tightly and control business KPI numbers rigorously.
Delve deeply into demand signals and traffic data to decipher business and marketing.
strategies for the LOB.
Understand new markets and segments, analyze trends and customer behavior, and
collaborate with marketing, supply, and product teams to maximize conversion based on
those trends.
Follow a stringent action plan and collaborate with the product team to increase platform
conversion.
Work with product teams to automate/improve pricing, business reporting, and
alerting mechanisms.
Collaborate with the operations team to devise and ensure smooth post-sale processes for
the online channel.
 AI & Strategic Initiatives 
Lead the GenAI charter for the Revenue team, identifying and prioritising AI use cases
across pricing, competition watch, consumer behaviour, fraud and leakage, and customer
experience.
Partner with product, tech and analytics teams to take AI projects from pilot to scale, with
clear revenue and efficiency outcomes.
Run competition and macro tracking across key international markets, including price
competitiveness and rate parity versus global OTAs.
Build and scale partnerships and affiliate channels to acquire new users and grow
cross-sell into International Hotels.
 Data Analytics 
Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations by interpreting and analyzing data,
integrating various reporting components from multiple data sources.
Proficiency in SQL, Adobe Analytics, and Advanced MS Excel is essential as this role
entails extensive data crunching.
Proactively analyze data using statistical methods to address key questions
from stakeholders or self-initiated curiosity. Develop insights into what drives business
performance, identify trends, and enhance online conversion for International Hotels.

 Qualification & Experience: 
MBA from reputed institute with 10-13 years of experience in business/ revenue/ category
role for a consumer facing technology enabled business/product from ecommerce
industry.
Experience in international markets, OTAs or hospitality, and exposure to AI-led
initiatives, will be preferred.

Mindset that will constantly think about Return on Investment, business and revenue.
Passion for data and an exceptional ability to solve complex problems.
Strong communication skills, Influencing skills, great interpersonal & stakeholder
management skills.
High on energy, team player coupled with a great attitude.

 About Us: 
Nurtured from the seed of a single great idea - to empower the traveler - MakeMyTrip went on
to pioneer India’s online travel industry. Founded in the year 2000 by Deep Kalra, MakeMyTrip
has since transformed how India travels. One of our most memorable moments has been to
ring the bell at NASDAQ in 2010. 
Post-merger with the Ibibio group in 2017, we created a stronger identity and traction for our
portfolio of brands (MakeMyTrip and redBus), increasing the pace of product and technology

solutions for our customers. Today as clear market leaders in India’s online travel space for air
ticketing, hotel reservations and bus bookings, we foster innovation to accelerate growth in
these travel segments.

 At MMT, our vision is to make travel simple and fun for all, and our core values guide us in
making this possible. These core values can be seen in the projects that we undertake, and
the way in which we solve problems for our customers. They are a representation of OUR
BEING & OUR DOING.

At MMT we believe that success lies in living our values of Being Caring, Curious and
Creative which enables us to deliver Customer Focus, Continuous Improvement and
Commitment to Results.

NEOLYTIX Management Trainee, RCM Revenue Cycle Management | Full-Time Opportunity | Gurugram DEPARTMENT Revenue Cycle Management LOCATION Gurugram (Onsite) SHIFT US Shift (5:00 PM2:00 AM IST) US Shift: This role operates on a US-aligned schedule, 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, 5 days a week, onsite at our Gurugram office. Please apply only if you can fully commit to this schedule. Eligibility Gate: Open to 2025 and 2026 graduates. Candidates who completed graduation in 2024 may apply and will be considered on a case-by-case basis, subject to approval. Candidates currently pursuing their degree or who graduated before 2024 are not eligible. The 6-Month Learning Journey Joining Neolytix as a Management Trainee, RCM is a full-time opportunity that begins with a structured 6 month learning journey. You are not thrown on the floor from day one. You will be trained, assessed, and made ready for live operations before you independently handle client work. Every stage of the journey is designed to build your skills progressively. Phase 1 Classroom Training 8 to 12 Days (Max 14) Structured instructor-led sessions covering US healthcare, medical billing, coding basics, and RCM workflows. Your LOB is decided within the first 2 to 3 days based on your performance, knowledge check, and operations team input. Phase 2 Operations Readiness Training 8 to 12 Days You move to the floor alongside senior team members and trainers. You apply classroom learning in a supervised, live operations environment with ongoing assessments. Phase 3 Production Ramp-Up 4 Weeks You begin handling real client work under close supervision. Accuracy, speed, and process adherence are tracked. Performance here determines your readiness to go live independently. Phase 4 Go Live Full Production You are cleared for independent production on your assigned LOB. This marks your transition from trainee to fully operational team member. Throughout the 6 months, there will be several assessments to evaluate your skill development. Your training path and LOB may be refined based on these assessment outcomes. Career Path Neolytix promotes from within. Here is where this journey takes you: Management Trainee Associate 1 Associate 2 Senior Associate 1 QA / SME About the Role Neolytix is a US-headquartered healthcare managed services organization serving 270+ provider organizations across the United States. We are building our next generation of RCM professionals through this full-time opportunity and we are looking for fresh graduates who are motivated, disciplined, and ready to build a real career in US healthcare operations. Revenue Cycle Management is how US healthcare providers get paid for the services they deliver. As a Management Trainee, you will be assessed, trained, and placed into one of three core RCM functional areas based on your skills and performance during the first days of training. Your LOB is not a default assignment. It is matched to where you will thrive. The Three RCM Areas Charge Posting & Payment Posting Accounts Receivable (AR) Translating patient services into medical billing codes and submitting claims to insurers, plus recording and reconciling payments received. Requires speed, accuracy, and coding discipline. Following up on submitted claims, resolving denials, and ensuring payments are collected from insurance payers. Requires analytical thinking, persistence, and clear communication. Credentialing Enrolling healthcare providers with insurance payers so they can legally bill for services. Covers CAQH, PECOS, payer portals, expirables, and compliance. Requires strong process discipline and attention to deadlines. Your LOB assignment is made within the first 2 to 3 days of classroom training, based on your knowledge check scores and the evaluation of the operations team. Once assigned, your entire training is aligned to that LOB. Key Responsibilities Attend and complete all classroom training modules within the defined timeline, meeting assessment benchmarks at each stage. Commit to the LOB assigned to you and engage fully in the training path designed for that functional area. Apply classroom learning during operations readiness training under the supervision of senior team members and trainers. Meet accuracy and productivity benchmarks during the 4-week production ramp-up before going live independently. Support team leads and senior specialists in achieving client SLAs and compliance targets once on the floor. Continuously learn and adapt to US payer requirements, billing rules, and client-specific workflows. Demonstrate consistent progress through assessments to qualify for transition to Associate 1. What You Bring Must-Have Bachelor's degree in any discipline, fully completed. Candidates currently pursuing a degree or with an incomplete graduation are not eligible. Graduated in 2025 or 2026. Candidates from 2024 will be considered on an exceptional basis only. Minimum 70% aggregate in 12th grade (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent board). Minimum 70% aggregate in graduation. Excellent spoken and written English. You will be trained on and operate in live US healthcare processes. Basic proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word. Full commitment to the US shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, onsite in Gurugram, 5 days a week. Preferred Schooling from Delhi NCR or Tier 1 or Tier 2 cosmopolitan cities. Science or Commerce with Mathematics background (B.Sc, BCA, BBA, B.Com, or similar). Any internship or prior exposure to US healthcare, medical billing, or BPO operations. Eligibility Criteria Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline, fully completed. No exceptions for incomplete or in progress degrees. Batch: 2025 and 2026 graduates are the primary eligible batch. 2024 graduates may be considered on an exceptional basis subject to thorough review and approval. Academic Scores: Minimum 70% aggregate in 12th grade (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent) and minimum 70% in graduation. Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory. Communication below this standard will not progress past the assessment stage. Systems: Basic MS Excel and MS Word. Comfortable learning new billing and EHR software during training. Shift: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, onsite in Gurugram, 5 days a week. Non-negotiable. Notice Period: Immediate joiners strongly preferred. Performance Expectations During the Learning Journey Assessment pass rate: minimum passing threshold on every module assessment throughout classroom and OJT phases. Attendance: full attendance during all training phases is expected without exception. Assignment completion: all practice tasks and training exercises completed on time. Ramp-up accuracy: error rate within acceptable threshold during the 4-week production ramp-up. Production readiness: cleared for independent live work by end of the learning journey. Post Go Live Daily productivity: meet case or task targets for the assigned LOB consistently. Quality: accuracy rate maintained within client and internal benchmarks. SLA contribution: support team-level SLA compliance on assigned client accounts. Hiring Process Stage 1: Resume Screening. Verified against eligibility criteria: graduation year, degree completion, 70% score thresholds, and shift readiness. Stage 2: Pre-Hire Assessment. Aptitude, comprehension, and communication test conducted at the Gurugram office. Evaluates English proficiency, analytical basics, and role readiness. Stage 3: Technical Interview. Interview with the Training Department to assess learning ability, communication standard, and initial LOB suitability. Stage 4: Counseling Session. Shortlisted candidates attend a session with the Analytics and Operations team to fully understand the role, the learning journey, the shift, and career expectations before a final decision is made. Stage 5: Offer. Benefits & Perks Group Health Insurance: Medical insurance coverage. Complimentary Dinner: One meal provided during shift hours at the Gurugram office. Cab Facility: Two-way pick-up and drop for the night shift. Why Join Neolytix Structured Learning, Real Work Defined Career Ladder 6 months of structured training before going live on client accounts, not tutorials, not simulations. You build real skills on real processes. Management Trainee to Associate 1 to Associate 2 to Senior Associate to QA or SME. Your pace is driven by your performance. Role & responsibilities: 
 1. Investment Management Design, implement, and manage the group's and family's investment strategy across listed equities, fixed income, mutual funds, PMS/AIFs, private equity, and real estate. Conduct independent fundamental research on companies and sectors (financials, business quality, governance, red-flag analysis) to support investment decisions. Treasury & Banking Manage banking relationships for the corporate holding entity, including credit facilities, cash management, and fund deployment. Optimize liquidity across the group to balance investment opportunities against working capital needs of operating businesses. Reporting & Governance Prepare periodic (monthly/quarterly) investment and net-worth reports for the family and the Board, covering performance, risk exposure, and market outlook. Support Board and family meetings with data-driven insights and recommendations. 5. This position offers direct exposure to engineering, manufacturing, assembly, testing, supplier development, and customer-focused product solutions within a global engineering environment. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Product Package Engineering 
 Design and develop centrifugal compressor packages and associated auxiliary systems in accordance with customer requirements, applicable standards, and company design practices. Lead engineering activities related to package layout, piping systems, lubrication systems, instrumentation, structural skid design, and package integration. Support new product development initiatives and product enhancement projects to improve performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost competitiveness. Develop and maintain technical specifications, engineering documentation, Bill of Materials (BOM), product configurations, and design standards. Perform engineering calculations, sizing, tolerance stack-up analysis, and design validation activities. 
 
 Design Manufacturing Support 
 Work closely with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, sourcing, and project execution teams during package fabrication and assembly. Provide technical support for manufacturing challenges, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and design improvements. Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and product validation activities. Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), performance testing, and customer inspections. 
 
 Supplier Quality Management 
 Collaborate with suppliers for component development, qualification, and technical evaluation. Support supplier quality initiatives, part approval processes, and reliability improvement activities. Evaluate technical proposals and recommend design improvements to enhance product quality and operational performance. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Coordinate with compressor design, electrical, controls, instrumentation, piping, structural, manufacturing, and sourcing teams. Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Support project execution teams in resolving technical issues and customer-related queries. Participate in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions as required. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering or any associated streams, from a recognized university with strong academic credentials. Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in product design, development, or package engineering of air compressors, centrifugal compressors, or rotating equipment systems. Experience working within a manufacturing or plant engineering environment is preferred. 
 
 Key Competencies 
 
 Technical Competencies 
 centrifugal compressors Mechanical design 3D CAD modeling (Creo) Tolerance stack-up analysis Design for Manufacturing (DFM) Design for Assembly (DFA) Bill of Materials (BOM) Oracle ERP Reliability engineering 
 
 Professional Competencies 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively on projects with limited definition and convert concepts into actionable engineering solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to diverse audiences. Strong teamwork, collaboration, and stakeholder management capabilities. Self-driven with a continuous improvement mindset and focus on execution excellence. 
 
 Preferred Experience 
 Manufacturing plant or factory engineering experience. Exposure to API standards and industrial compressor applications. Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and product localization initiatives. Knowledge of industrial air systems and customer applications across various industries. Experience working in global engineering teams and multinational organizations.

We are hiring a hands-on Service Delivery Manager to run day-to-day production support for our Big Data and data integration platforms. You will lead a support pod of L1/L2/L3 engineers, act as incident commander for critical outages, own SLA delivery, and drive the automation agenda that removes recurring manual work.

 Incident & Problem Management Act as incident commander for P1/P2 production outages drive triage bridges, coordinate cross-team resolution, and manage business communication until service restoration. Own and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation within agreed SLAs; track corrective and preventive actions to closure. Run problem management for recurring issues; convert known errors into permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds. SLA & Metric Governance Track, report, and enforce response and resolution SLAs across the ticket queue; manage backlog, ageing, and breach risk proactively. Publish weekly and monthly KPI packs MTTR, MTTD, SLA compliance, ticket volume and trend, availability, automation savings to leadership. Own the operational review cadence with business and technology stakeholders. People & Team Leadership Manage 16/7 or 24/7 rotational support rosters, shift handovers, on-call schedules, and holiday coverage. Mentor and coach support engineers; build technical depth and runbook discipline across the team. Conduct performance reviews, goal setting, and development planning; participate actively in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding. Automation & Continuous Improvement Identify high-frequency, high-effort manual tasks and replace them with automation scripts, self-healing routines, and auto-remediation. Improve monitoring and alerting frameworks to shift from reactive to predictive detection; reduce alert noise and false positives. Maintain and continually improve runbooks, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures. Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with software engineering, DevOps, and product teams to review upcoming deployments and assess release readiness. Represent support in CAB and change approval forums; enforce operational readiness criteria before production releases. Feed stability pain points, defect trends, and supportability gaps back into the development backlog. 
 Must Have Hands-on experience supporting Hadoop ecosystem components (HDFS, Hive, Spark, YARN, Sqoop, Oozie). Working experience with IBM InfoSphere DataStage — job design, scheduling, failure triage, and performance troubleshooting. Strong Splunk skills — building queries, dashboards, and alerts for log analysis and monitoring. Strong SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation. Scripting/programming in Python , Java , or Shell for automation and tooling. ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management; ServiceNow or JIRA. title: Customer Service, Escalation - Team Manager (Hindi)
description:
Job Summary 
 You are more than a people leader, you are a proactive owner, comfortable juggling many things at once, being the calm, emotionally intelligent guide for a team that works under pressure every day. You will own your teams day-to-day performance and help deliver the wider Agoda and CSI teams goals, working closely with business partners so we succeed together. Everything you do comes back to one aim: the best possible resolution for our customers, based on the worst escalations or situations. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Coach, mentor and manage a team CSI specialists, building a culture of excellence, accountability and continuous learning. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback, manage performance and development plans; address performance or behaviour gaps directly. Coach beyond the task at hand, so your team builds strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills for complex escalations. Own your goals and projects from start to finish, whether they are assigned to you or ones you start yourself. Turn challenges into clear actions, track progress and report on results. Be the key decision-maker for your team during complex, high-stakes escalations. Give clear direction, manage communication with stakeholders and steer each case to a controlled, effective resolution. Stay calm and prioritise your teams time when several high-stakes events happen at once, and turn complex, high-risk issues into short, clear updates with next steps for senior leadership. Find the root causes of recurring escalations and push for lasting fixes, not just quick workarounds. Suggest improvements, take part in lessons-learned reviews after escalations, or incidents, and share what you learn. Build strong relationships with internal partners such as Legal, Public Relations, Product, Supply and senior leadership, influencing without direct authority to clear blockers, so that work for your market or area runs smoothly. Balance requests from different leaders against your teams capacity and push back on escalations or work that do not belong with the team. Manage your teams escalation queue and backlog. Keep a close eye on incoming case volumes, look beyond the dashboards for unusual patterns in case routing, volumes or team performance, spot issues early and act quickly to make sure service levels are met. Use raw data, dashboards and performance reports to diagnose gaps, suggest improvements and build the case for change.

 Job Summary 
 The Microsoft 365 Client Success Specialist will be responsible for ensuring that customers successfully adopt, utilize, and derive maximum value from Microsoft 365 solutions. This role acts as a trusted advisor to UK based business clients, driving user engagement, solution optimization, and long-term customer satisfaction through proactive guidance, technical expertise, and relationship management. The specialist collaborates with sales, support, and technical teams to deliver seamless onboarding, ongoing enablement, and continuous improvement aligned with client business goals. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 System Administration and Support: End-to-end administration of Microsoft 365 tenants, including user account management, licensing, and security compliance. Platform Configuration: Support and configuration of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Exchange Online. Workflow Automation: Utilize Power Platform (Power Automate, Power BI, Power Apps) to create efficient business solutions. Data Analysis Reporting: Perform audit log evaluations, monitor system usage, and generate reports on platform performance. User Training Documentation: Create documentation, provide troubleshooting support, and train employees on M365 collaboration tools. Security Compliance: Implement and monitor data security policies to prevent data loss. Client Onboarding Adoption Management: Plan and execute structured onboarding programs for new Microsoft 365 customers, ensuring smooth transition, user adoption, and early value realization. Customer Success Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, conducting regular check-ins, success reviews, and health assessments to ensure customer satisfaction and retention. Incident Escalation Management: Manage service incidents, coordinate with Microsoft support and internal resolver teams, track SLAs, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues. Change Management Feature Rollout: Plan and support Microsoft 365 feature updates, roadmap changes, and tenant-wide deployments, ensuring minimal business disruption and effective communication to stakeholders. License Optimization Cost Management: Analyze license usage and recommend optimization strategies to reduce cost, improve utilization, and align licensing with business needs. Governance Best Practices Implementation: Design and enforce governance models for Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive including naming conventions, lifecycle management, access controls, and information architecture. Integration Ecosystem Support: Support integration of Microsoft 365 with third-party tools, identity systems (Azure AD / Entra ID), and line-of-business applications used by customers. Knowledge Management Continuous Improvement: Maintain internal knowledge bases, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and lessons learned to improve service delivery and operational efficiency. 
 
 Pre-Requisites 
 3 plus years of hands-on experience in Microsoft 365 administration and support. Deep knowledge of M365 services (Teams, SharePoint, Exchange). Experience in a client-facing or customer-success role, preferably in IT services, MSPs or SaaS environments. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, and data analysis. Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, often in second-line support roles. Strong interpersonal skills for stakeholder management and training. Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant post-graduate certifications or diplomas in Cloud Computing or Microsoft technologies are an advantage

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
Job Objective 
 https://crayonlyf.com 
 The Customer Support Officer will be responsible for handling customer queries, resolving app-related issues, assisting customers with orders and payments, supporting vendor-related requests, and ensuring timely resolution of complaints. 
 The candidate will serve as a key point of contact between customers, vendors, and internal teams to maintain customer satisfaction and build trust in the brand. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Customer Support & Query Resolution Respond to customer queries through phone calls, email, WhatsApp, chat, and other designated support channels. Assist parents and users with app registration, login, profile management, navigation, and general feature-related queries. Provide accurate information about the parenting app, its features, services, and available resources. Understand customer concerns and provide timely, professional, and helpful resolutions. Escalate technical issues, complaints, and complex cases to the appropriate internal team. Maintain a polite, empathetic, and customer-friendly approach in every interaction. 2. E-commerce Customer Support Assist customers with product enquiries, order placement, order status, delivery updates, cancellations, returns, refunds, and replacement requests. Coordinate with vendors, logistics partners, and internal operations teams to resolve order-related issues. Help customers understand product information, pricing, availability, and applicable policies. Track complaints and follow up until the issue is resolved. Support customers with payment-related queries and coordinate with the relevant team when transactions require investigation. Ensure customers receive clear updates regarding their requests and complaints. 3. Vendor Support & Coordination Assist onboarded vendors with registration, account access, product listings, catalogue updates, and general platform-related queries. Guide vendors through the onboarding process and help them understand marketplace procedures. Coordinate with vendors to resolve product availability, order fulfilment, and customer complaint issues. Follow up on pending vendor requests and ensure timely communication. Maintain professional relationships with vendors to improve their experience on the platform. 4. Complaint Management & Customer Satisfaction Record, categorise, prioritise, and track customer complaints. Follow defined response and resolution timelines. Maintain a record of recurring customer issues and recommend improvements to the support process. Collect customer feedback and share suggestions for improving the app and shopping experience. Proactively follow up on unresolved cases to ensure customer satisfaction. Handle sensitive customer information responsibly and follow company privacy and data protection policies. 5. Reporting & Coordination Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, complaints, resolutions, and escalations in the designated CRM or tracking system. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly customer support reports. Coordinate with development, sales, marketing, operations, and vendor management teams. Identify recurring technical or operational problems and report them to the appropriate team. Assist in creating FAQs, standard responses, support guides, and knowledge-base articles. Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate in any discipline; candidates with customer service, business administration, or communication backgrounds will be preferred. 03 years of experience in customer support, customer service, e-commerce operations, or a similar role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn may also apply. Good verbal and written communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali. Strong listening, problem-solving, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills. Basic understanding of mobile applications, websites, e-commerce platforms, and online payments. Familiarity with email, WhatsApp Business, MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM or ticketing tools. Ability to manage multiple customer requests while maintaining accuracy and professionalism. Patient, empathetic, organised, and comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be assessed against the following metrics: Average first-response time. Average complaint resolution time. Customer satisfaction score (CSAT). First-contact resolution rate. Number of customer queries resolved within the defined SLA. Accuracy of customer records and support documentation. Quality of communication and customer feedback. Effectiveness of vendor coordination and issue resolution. Number of pending and overdue support tickets.

title: UPS Service Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION : NAPS 
 Position: Service Engineer 
 Department: Service 
 Job Summary : 
 - We are looking for a motivated and technically oriented Service Engineer to join our 
- Service & Support team. The candidate will be responsible for attending customer service requirements, breakdown calls, preventive maintenance, installations, commissioning, and troubleshooting of UPS systems and related electrical/electronic equipment. 
 - The role requires good technical understanding, willingness to travel to customer sites, problem solving ability, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. 
 Key Responsibilities 
- Complete all assigned breakdown calls and customer complaints within the required timeline. 
 -Attend preventive maintenance (PM), minor service calls, installations, and commissioning as assigned. 
 - Troubleshoot UPS systems and identify electrical, electronic, battery, and system related faults. 
 - Handle repeat breakdowns with appropriate technical support and escalation when required. 
 - Identify the root cause of equipment failures and implement suitable 
 corrective actions. 
 - Work toward reducing repeated customer complaints, equipment downtime, and unnecessary spare consumption. 
 - Provide proper customer feedback, service updates, and technical reports to the Service Manager. 
 - Prepare and submit accurate service reports, installation reports, 
 commissioning reports, and preventive maintenance reports. 
 - Ensure proper site preparation, installation, commissioning, testing, and documentation for higher-kVA UPS systems. 
- Follow approved service procedures, safety standards, and company guidelines while working at customer sites. 
 - Check system performance after repair, installation, or commissioning and ensure proper handover to the customer. 
- Coordinate with the Service Manager and technical team for critical or 
 unresolved issues. 
- Maintain proper records of tools, spare parts, replaced components, and service activities. 
 - Maintain professional communication and a positive relationship with 
 customers. 
 -Travel to customer locations as required for service and technical support. 
- Continuously develop technical knowledge of UPS systems, batteries, electrical systems, and power electronics. 
 Educational Qualification: 
 ITI / Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering. 
 Candidates from related electrical/electronics backgrounds may also be 
 considered based on technical aptitude. 
 Experience 
 Freshers are welcome. 
 No prior work experience is required. 
 Candidates with relevant service, electrical, electronics, UPS, or power 
 electronics experience may also be considered. 
 Required Skills 
 Basic knowledge of electrical and electronic circuits. 
 Basic understanding of UPS systems, batteries, power electronics, and 
 electrical equipment. 
 Ability to read and understand basic electrical/electronic drawings and wiring diagrams. 
 Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 Willingness to work at customer sites and travel as required. 
 Good communication and customer-handling skills. 
 Ability to prepare basic technical/service reports. 
 Willingness to learn new technologies and service procedures. 
 Ability to work independently as well as part of a technical team. 
 Key Performance Areas 
 Timely completion of assigned service and breakdown calls. 
 Elective troubleshooting and first-time resolution wherever possible. 
 Reduction of repeat breakdowns and customer complaints. 
 Proper utilization and control of service spares. 
 Quality of installation and commissioning activities. 
 Timely submission and accuracy of service reports. 
 Customer satisfaction and professional service conduct. 
 Compliance with safety and company service procedures. 
 Personal Attributes 
 Positive attitude and willingness to learn. 
 Responsible and disciplined approach to work. 
 Customer-focused mindset. 
 Good teamwork and coordination. 
 Strong troubleshooting attitude. 
 Ability to work under pressure during critical breakdowns. 
 Willingness to travel and work at different customer locations. 
 Candidate Profile 
 This position is suitable for ITI/Diploma freshers in Electrical or Electronics who are 
 interested in building a career in UPS service, electrical systems, power electronics, 
 installation, commissioning, and technical customer support.

title: Branding Head
company: NEVORA HEALTH AND BEAUTY  PVT LTD
description:
About the Company 
 NEVORA HEALTH & BEAUTY PVT. LTD. is an upcoming consumer health and beauty company preparing to launch in January 2027. Our portfolio will include health supplements, nutraceuticals, skincare, haircare and personal care products. Our business model focuses on sourcing products from third-party manufacturers and building our own consumer brand through repacking, relabelling, marketing and online and offline sales. 
 We are looking for an experienced, strategic and execution-oriented Head Branding & Marketing to establish NEVORA's brand identity, develop effective marketing strategies and build a strong market presence. 
 Job Summary 
 The Head Branding & Marketing will lead the company's brand strategy, product positioning, marketing communications, product launch planning and brand development activities. The candidate will be responsible for creating a consistent brand identity, understanding consumer behaviour, coordinating marketing campaigns and building brand awareness while contributing to business growth and profitability. The ideal candidate should be capable of building a brand from the ground up in a fast-growing startup environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Brand Strategy & Development 
 Develop and implement NEVORA's overall brand strategy and positioning. Build a consistent brand identity, brand guidelines, messaging and communication strategy. Conduct market research, competitor analysis and consumer insights. Identify target audiences, market opportunities and product differentiation strategies. Develop long-term brand-building initiatives aligned with business objectives. 
 2. Product Branding & Launch Management 
 Develop branding strategies for nutraceuticals, health supplements, skincare, haircare and personal care products. Coordinate product naming, packaging design, label design, product presentation and marketing materials. Work with third-party manufacturers, designers and packaging vendors to coordinate product launch requirements. Ensure packaging, product descriptions and promotional claims undergo the required regulatory review before use. Plan launch calendars and coordinate timely product introductions. 
 3. Marketing Campaigns & Brand Awareness 
 Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital and relevant offline channels. Develop brand communication strategies for social media, website content, advertising and promotional activities. Coordinate with creative agencies, graphic designers, video editors, influencers and content creators. Develop marketing calendars and ensure consistency in brand communication. Monitor campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements based on measurable results. 
 4. Digital Marketing & E-commerce Coordination 
 Work closely with the e-commerce and performance marketing teams to support online business growth. Coordinate brand presence across the company website and relevant marketplaces, including Amazon and Flipkart. Support customer acquisition, product visibility, conversion and repeat-purchase initiatives. Ensure brand consistency across product listings, advertisements and digital platforms. Review campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency. 
 5. Sales Growth & Business Support 
 Develop marketing initiatives that support revenue growth and customer acquisition. Coordinate with sales teams on product promotions, distributor presentations and retail marketing materials. Support market expansion through suitable online and offline channels. Work with management to develop pricing, promotional and product portfolio recommendations. Align branding investments with product margins, marketing budgets and commercial objectives. 
 6. Budget & Performance Management 
 Prepare and manage the annual and monthly brand marketing budget. Monitor marketing expenditure and campaign performance. Track brand awareness, customer acquisition, sales growth and marketing efficiency. Prepare monthly brand performance reports and recommendations for management. Ensure marketing investments contribute to sustainable business growth. 
 7. Team & Agency Management Coordinate with e-commerce, sales, operations and customer support teams. Manage external marketing agencies, designers, production vendors and creative partners. Establish clear deliverables, timelines and performance expectations. Build internal marketing capabilities as the business grows. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 5 TO 10 years of experience in brand management, brand marketing or integrated marketing. Experience in cosmetics, skincare, personal care, FMCG, wellness or nutraceuticals is strongly preferred. Proven experience in developing brand strategies and executing product launches. Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, brand positioning and marketing communications. Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies and cross-functional teams. Understanding of digital marketing and e-commerce channels. Strong leadership, communication, analytical and project management skills. Ability to work independently and execute strategies in a startup environment. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Successful product launches and launch timelines. Brand awareness and growth in target-market reach. Consistency of brand identity across customer touchpoints. Marketing campaign effectiveness and budget utilisation. Contribution to sales growth and customer acquisition. Product positioning and market differentiation. Marketing efficiency and contribution to product profitability. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for a proactive brand-building professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Candidates who have built or repositioned consumer brands, launched multiple products, managed marketing budgets and delivered measurable results will be preferred. Experience in a growing D2C company or startup will be an advantage. 
 What We Offer 
 Opportunity to build a new health and beauty brand from the ground up. Direct involvement in brand strategy and business decisions. Opportunity to lead product launches and marketing initiatives. A performance-driven startup environment with opportunities for growth.

Key Skills: Brand strategy,Awareness,Branding,Strategic planning,Marketing,Strategic marketing planning,Promotions,Brand
